jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: **Location:** Palo Alto, CA (5 days/week in office) · **Type:** Full\-time · **YOE:** 2yr\+ FDE experiences. (Bonus) technical sales, technical consultant or AI/SaaS founder experience · **Compensation:** competitive base \+ equity **About us** ------------ We're building toward a world where every company can become its own AI lab. Goaly is an early\-stage AI startup founded by ex\-Meta Superintelligence Labs engineers and researchers. Our founders built the Llama Research Platform that every Llama post\-training run landed on, and led post\-training efficiency on Meta's Superintelligence team. Our mission is to dramatically lower the cost, time, and talent barriers to building proprietary AI — and make each generation of models faster and cheaper to build than the last. Goaly is the autonomous performance layer for AI training. It watches every job across a GPU fleet, catches the runs that are wasting compute, reallocates what it frees up, and shows teams what each model improvement actually costs. It runs on\-prem, telemetry\-only, and starts read\-only. Backed by leading AI investors and endorsed by frontier AI researchers and builders, we're looking for an engineer who can walk into a prospect's GPU cluster, get Goaly running, and prove its value fast enough that the pilot becomes a contract. We’re building toward a world where every company can become its own AI lab. Goaly is a stealth AI startup founded by ex\-Meta MSL engineers and researchers. Our mission is to dramatically lower the cost, time, and talent barriers to building proprietary AI — and make each generation of models faster and cheaper to build than the last. Backed by leading AI investors and endorsed by frontier AI researchers and builders, we’re looking for exceptional new grads who want to work on hard, foundational AI systems problems with outsized ownership from day one. **About the role** ------------------ You will be one of our first Forward Deployed Engineers, working directly with the founding team. Your job is to shorten the path from "interesting first call" to "signed customer." You will own three things: * **Run technical evaluations that close.** Scope, deploy, and run Goaly pilots inside prospect environments, and turn each one into a clear, numbers\-backed result the buyer can take to their leadership. * **Be the technical voice in the deal.** Join discovery and evaluation calls, answer the hard infrastructure and security questions on the spot, and remove the blockers that stall deals. * **Bring the field back into the product.** Turn what you see in real clusters into integrations, fixes, and product changes, so every next deployment is faster than the last. You need strong systems engineering skills, because you will work inside other people's infrastructure with limited access and real constraints. You need customer instincts, because the job is to make the prospect successful first and Goaly successful as a result. You do not need a background in model research. This is a founding role. There is no playbook yet; you help write it, and the deployment process you build becomes how Goaly scales to every customer after you. **What you'll do** ------------------ ### **Deploy Goaly in prospect environments** * Scope each pilot with the prospect: which clusters, which workloads, what success looks like, and how we will measure it. * Install and configure Goaly on\-prem across the stacks our customers run (Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and in\-house schedulers), in read\-only, telemetry\-only mode. * Work through security reviews, network constraints, and access approvals with the prospect's platform and security teams. * Debug what breaks in real environments: odd scheduler setups, missing metrics, custom training stacks. ### **Prove the value and convert** * Turn pilot data into a clear business case: compute wasted, compute recovered, and the cost of each model improvement. * Present results to ML leads, infra leads, and the executives who sign. * Partner with GTM on deal strategy, technical objections, and the path from pilot to paid deployment. * Keep each evaluation on a tight timeline, and flag early when a deal is at risk. ### **Build what the field needs** * Write the integrations, scripts, and connectors that a deployment needs, and push the reusable ones back into the product. * Build and maintain demo environments and reference deployments for sales calls. * Turn repeated questions into docs, runbooks, and install guides, so time\-to\-value drops with every customer. ### **Feed the roadmap** * Bring precise, prioritized field feedback to engineering and the founders: what customers need, what blocks adoption, and what wins deals. * Reproduce customer issues and work with engineering until they ship a fix. **What a typical week looks like** ---------------------------------- * Two days on active pilots: on\-site or remote in a prospect's cluster, installing, debugging, and pulling results. * A day on deal calls: discovery, technical deep dives, security reviews, and results readouts. * A day building: an integration a prospect needs, a better install path, or a demo environment. * A day with the team: engineering sync on field feedback, GTM sync on pipeline, and founder time on what we learned. * \[Roughly X percent travel] for on\-site deployments and customer visits. **You may be a good fit if you have** ------------------------------------- * **A strong engineering background:** \[2–5] years as a software, infrastructure, or ML engineer. You write production\-quality code (Python required; Go or Rust a plus). * **Hands\-on infra experience:** you have run or debugged workloads on Kubernetes, Slurm, or Ray, and you are comfortable on Linux, in cloud and on\-prem environments. * **Customer\-facing technical experience:** as an FDE, solutions engineer, sales engineer, or similar. You have taken a customer from a blank page to a working result. * **Clear communication:** you can explain a technical result to an engineer in the morning and to a VP in the afternoon. * **Ownership under ambiguity:** you drive a deployment to the finish line without a detailed spec or someone checking in. **Strong pluses** ----------------- * Experience with GPU clusters and distributed training (PyTorch, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron, or similar). * Experience with observability and telemetry (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, OpenTelemetry). * Experience at an AI infra, MLOps, or developer\-tools company with an enterprise sales motion. * Experience with enterprise security reviews and on\-prem software deployments. * Startup or founder experience. **Reasons to take this job** ---------------------------- * You work on the most compute\-intensive workloads in the industry, inside the clusters of the teams that run them. * You see the direct impact of your work: every pilot you run is a deal that closes or doesn't. * Your feedback goes straight into the roadmap, with no layers between you and the founders who built post\-training infra at Llama scale. * You build the FDE function from 0 to 1, with a clear path to leading it as it grows. * Great vibe: a strong (and fun) team who worked at the frontier before, substantial GPU capacity to test ideas, and real customers to build with. **Reasons to not take this job** -------------------------------- * You want to work only on the core product, not inside customer environments. * You don't want to be on calls with customers, or to travel for on\-site deployments. * You want a narrow scope. This role moves between engineering, deals, and product every week. * You want a playbook. There isn't one yet. **Location, visa sponsorship \& benefits** ------------------------------------------ * **Hybrid in Palo Alto:** 4\+ days/week in office. * **Visa sponsorship:** H\-1B and OPT/CPT support available, with immigration counsel. * **Meals \& perks:** Complimentary lunch, dinner, snacks, and drinks. **How to apply** ---------------- **Send us 2 links or short write\-ups to start:** something you built or deployed in a customer environment, and a technical problem you solved under real constraints (limited access, a deadline, an unhappy customer). If you can't share details, tell us in a paragraph how you would run a 2\-week Goaly pilot on a prospect's 500\-GPU cluster. **A note on qualifications.** We value exceptional ability over perfect keyword matches. If the work excites you and you can show strong technical ability, customer instinct, and ownership, we encourage you to apply. **Equal opportunity** --------------------- We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates who need them during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer (Control Systems)
jobs.description: **Benefits:** * Paid time off * 401(k) * Competitive salary * Opportunity for advancement * Stock options plan **About the Role:** Radiant Robotics is looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on Controls Systems to join our innovative development team in San Leandro, CA. This is an exciting opportunity to apply advanced control strategies to magnetic levitation systems, helping to shape the future of intelligent automation and robotics. If you're passionate about building smart, data\-driven physical AI systems with real\-world impact, we want to hear from you. **Responsibilities:** * Design control strategies including PID, model predictive control and learned policies, and recommend which to deploy. * Develop and optimize control algorithms using ML techniques such as reinforcement learning and predictive modeling. * Design, develop, and deploy ML models and apply in areas where they add value, including disturbance modeling, and trajectory optimization. * Build and maintain simulation models of dynamic magnetic forces, moving payloads, and the sensing chain, and validate them against bench measurements * Build and validate simulations of various control strategies by running comparative experiments. * Define performance metrics for the magnetic levitation system, such as positional error and report results against them. * Document models, assumptions, and results for analysis and improvement, and so that other engineers can reproduce and extend the work. * Work with firmware and electronics engineers to move proven strategies from simulation onto the real hardware and tune them in the loop. **Requirements:** * Master's degree or higher in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, robotics, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related field. * Working knowledge of control theory, including PID design and tuning, state\-space methods, and model predictive control (MPC). You can derive a plant model, linearize it, and explain the tradeoffs of each approach. * Applied machine learning experience, with at least one project where a learned model or policy improved a physical or simulated system. * Experience building dynamic simulations of physical systems and checking them against real measurements. * Proficiency in Python, C\+\+, or MATLAB/Simulink for controls and ML development * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain controller behavior to engineers outside the controls discipline. * Comfort using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or similar for simulations development. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience deploying controllers on embedded targets such as microcontrollers or real\-time Linux, and tuning them with hardware in the loop. * Experience with multi\-physics or finite element modeling of magnetic fields, for example with FEMM or COMSOL. Experience with designing, analyzing, or fabricating systems that generate or manipulate magnetic fields. * **About Us:** Radiant Robotics is an innovator and leader in magnetic levitation solutions, with a focus on warehousing and logistics applications. Radiant’s mission is to unify all materials handling workflows for warehousing and manufacturing into a single, simple intelligent automation platform. You will define verification architecture, develop reusable methodologies, drive coverage closure, and ensure designs meet functional, performance, and quality requirements. You will work closely with architecture, RTL design, analog/mixed\-signal, firmware, FPGA, emulation, and program teams to deliver high\-quality silicon. In this role, you will serve as both a hands\-on technical contributor and a verification leader, helping establish best practices and guiding other engineers through challenging verification efforts. **Key Responsibilities*** Lead verification strategy, planning, and execution for complex ASIC, SoC, subsystem, IP, and FPGA designs. * Define verification architecture, testbench structure, verification plans, coverage models, and signoff criteria. * Develop and maintain scalable verification environments using SystemVerilog, UVM, assertions, constrained\-random testing, and directed testing. * Create and review verification plans, functional coverage models, scoreboards, monitors, checkers, sequences, and reusable verification components. * Drive verification closure using functional coverage, code coverage, assertion coverage, regression results, and bug metrics. * Lead debug of complex failures across RTL, testbench, firmware, gate\-level simulation, emulation, and system\-level environments. * Collaborate closely with architects, RTL designers, analog/mixed\-signal engineers, firmware developers, and project leads to ensure complete and efficient verification. * Serve as the verification technical authority in customer architecture and signoff reviews. * Provide effort estimation and verification staffing input for proposals and new program pursuits. * Mentor junior and senior verification engineers through technical reviews, methodology guidance, and hands\-on debug support. * Improve verification productivity through automation, scripting, reusable infrastructure, and methodology enhancements. * Evaluate and apply industry\-standard tools and methodologies, including simulation, formal verification, emulation, FPGA prototyping, and verification management tools. * Support project planning by estimating verification scope, identifying risks, tracking progress, and communicating status to technical and program leadership. **Qualifications*** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. * Typically 12\+ years of ASIC, SoC, or FPGA design verification experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex verification efforts. * Expert\-level experience with SystemVerilog and UVM. * Strong background developing block\-level, subsystem\-level, or SoC\-level verification environments. * Experience creating verification plans, coverage models, constrained\-random tests, directed tests, assertions, and regression strategies. * Strong understanding of verification closure, including functional coverage, code coverage, assertion coverage, bug triage, and signoff methodology. * Hands\-on debug experience with complex RTL and testbench issues. * Proficiency with scripting and automation using languages such as Python, Perl, Tcl, shell scripting, or Make. * Experience with industry\-standard EDA simulation, debug, coverage, and verification management tools. * Strong technical leadership skills, including experience mentoring engineers and guiding verification execution. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to collaborate effectively across architecture, design, verification, analog, firmware, FPGA, and program teams. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience with high\-speed interfaces and protocols such as PCIe, CXL, DDR, LPDDR, Ethernet, USB, MIPI, AMBA, AXI, CHI, or UCIe. * Experience contributing to proposals, scoping, or technical pre\-sales in a design\-services context * Experience with formal verification, assertion\-based verification, or property checking. * Experience with gate\-level simulation, low\-power verification, UPF/CPF, reset verification, or X\-propagation analysis. * Experience with emulation, FPGA prototyping, hardware/software co\-verification, or post\-silicon bring\-up support. * Familiarity with mixed\-signal verification methodologies. * Experience working in customer\-facing engineering environments or design services organizations. **Why Join ForwardEdge ASIC?** At ForwardEdge ASIC, you will work on challenging silicon programs with a highly experienced engineering team. You will have the opportunity to influence verification strategy, contribute to advanced ASIC development, and help deliver high\-quality custom silicon solutions for leading\-edge applications. **What We Offer*** Work\-Life Balance: Flexible 9/80 work schedule with every other Friday off * Competitive Comp \& Benefits: Healthcare and medical coverage options, 401(k) retirement benefits with company contribution, generous holidays and PTO * Incentives: Eligibility for short\-term and long\-term incentive programs **Join ForwardEdge ASIC and be part of a team that thrives on innovation and excellence in ASIC design. jobs.title: Process Development Engineer — Autonomous Platforms Manufacturing
jobs.description: **The challenge** ----------------- Imagine launching a new autonomous platform while doubling output in 120 days—without compromising safety or quality. That’s the environment at Powerus, where we design and industrialize the production systems that safeguard critical assets across defense, national security, critical infrastructure, and commercial sectors. Our mission is clear: deliver resilient autonomous technologies that enhance safety and strengthen national security in complex operations. As we scale, we need process builders who thrive on ambiguity and turn it into disciplined execution. **Your 90\-day impact** ----------------------- * Stand up stable, documented processes for a key product line, complete with standard work and control plans. * Lead an 8D to eliminate a top Pareto defect; execute validations and capability studies. * Meet safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements; assist with audits. ### **Lead critical projects** * Run CI and capital projects end to end—scope, plan, execute, and sustain. * Manage timelines, budgets, resources, and stakeholder updates. * Advance facility expansion, automation, and modernization initiatives. **What makes you a fit** ------------------------ ### **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. ### **Experience** * 3–7 years in manufacturing or process engineering within a production setting. * Hands\-on NPI and ramp\-to\-volume experience. * Track record of implementing lean/CI improvements at the gemba. ### **Capabilities** * Lean and Six Sigma toolkit; building processes and standard work. * Root\-cause methods (8D, 5 Whys, fishbone), PFMEA, and control plan creation. * DFM and definition of tooling/fixture requirements. * SPC with strong analytical skills. * ERP and CAD proficiency; advanced Microsoft Excel. ### **Preferred background** * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification. * Automation, robotics, or modernization initiatives. * Experience in aerospace, automotive, or industrial sectors. * Knowledge of ISO 9001, IATF 16949, AS9100, or similar regulated environments. **How we build** ---------------- * Kaizen mindset * Lean manufacturing principles * Single\-piece flow ### **Tools** * NetSuite (ERP), CAD suites, and advanced Excel **Why Powerus** --------------- Join a mission\-driven team during a pivotal growth phase. Your work will directly shape how autonomous platforms are produced at scale—and how they perform when it matters most.

jobs.title: Validation Engineer
jobs.description: Position Description: At ForwardEdge ASIC we specialize in best\-in\-class ASIC technology, 100% domestically traceable microelectronic solutions designed for performance in commercial, aerospace, defense, and security sectors. FEASIC operates a full\-scale ASIC design shop with cross\-disciplinary fluency between digital logic, analog/mixed\-signal design, and physical layout, and sits at the intersection of advanced ASIC, FPGA, and microelectronics design. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Lockheed Martin, we combine the agility of a startup with the stability and scale of a Fortune 100 leader. We operate in a nimble, fast\-paced environment of 80\+ highly experienced and specialized engineers with over 25 years of ASIC/FPGA experience and more than 300 patents. We are seeking a **Staff Validation Engineer (L4\)** to lead post\-silicon validation and characterization of complex ASIC, FPGA, board, and subsystem designs. This Staff Validation Engineer owns validation strategy and execution for significant technical areas, translates specifications into measurable test coverage, and drives issues to root cause in close partnership with design, firmware, systems, PCB, and product engineering teams. The role combines hands\-on laboratory work with technical leadership, automation, documentation, and mentoring. **Key Responsibilities*** Own validation strategy, planning, execution, and closure for complex devices, interfaces, or subsystems from initial bring\-up through qualification and production readiness. * Translate product requirements, design specifications, schematics, register maps, and performance targets into detailed validation plans, test cases, coverage goals, and acceptance criteria. * Develop and maintain scalable laboratory validation environments, including test fixtures, evaluation boards, instrumentation, software, data acquisition, and result reporting. * Perform hands\-on bring\-up, functional validation, electrical characterization, margin testing, stress testing, and failure analysis across operating voltage, temperature, process, and workload conditions as applicable. * Select, configure, and use advanced test equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, source measure units, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, protocol analyzers, and bit\-error\-rate testers. * Develop automated test software and reusable tools in Python or comparable languages to improve test coverage, repeatability, throughput, traceability, and data quality. * Analyze large and complex data sets, identify anomalous behavior, isolate hardware and software interactions, and lead cross\-functional debug to determine root cause and corrective action. * Define validation requirements for PCB design, test access, fixtures, instrumentation, and laboratory infrastructure early in the development cycle. * Establish and improve validation methods, coding practices, review standards, coverage tracking, documentation, and release criteria for assigned programs. * Communicate status, risk, technical findings, and recommendations clearly to engineering teams and program stakeholders; document test procedures, results, limitations, and conclusions. * Mentor less\-experienced engineers, review validation plans and test implementations, and provide technical guidance without direct people\-management responsibility. * Support design reviews, silicon readiness, product qualification, production ramp, customer issue investigation, and reuse of validation environments on follow\-on programs. **Required Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of relevant experience in silicon validation, hardware validation, product engineering, systems test, or a closely related engineering discipline. * Demonstrated ownership of validation for a complex device, interface, subsystem, or product through planning, execution, debug, and closure. * Strong understanding of digital, analog, mixed\-signal, power, signal\-integrity, and embedded\-system fundamentals sufficient to diagnose cross\-domain failures. * Hands\-on expertise with laboratory test equipment and safe, repeatable measurement practices. * Proficiency developing test automation and data\-analysis tools, preferably using Python; working knowledge of version control and structured software\-development practices. * Ability to read and interpret specifications, schematics, layouts, register maps, timing diagrams, and component data sheets. * Proven ability to create clear validation plans, technical reports, and engineering documentation. * Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize and execute across multiple technical workstreams. * Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical reviews and influence cross\-functional decisions. **What We Offer*** Work\-Life Balance: Flexible 9/80 work schedule with every other Friday off * Competitive Comp \& Benefits: Healthcare and medical coverage options, 401(k) retirement benefits with company contribution, generous holidays and PTO * Incentives: Eligibility for short\-term and long\-term incentive programs ***Join ForwardEdge ASIC and be part of a team that thrives on innovation and excellence in ASIC design. Together, we build the technology that enables a safer, more resilient world.***

Responsibilities: **THE ROLE:** We are a high\-impact, forward\-thinking firmware team dedicated to advancing Data Center Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and Machine Intelligence Processing Units. Our mission spans the full platform lifecycle — from architecture, emulation, silicon bring\-up, production enablement, and customer escalation support. We are passionate about BIOS and platform firmware architecture, boot flow, system level debug, power and performance management, and building the firmware foundation that unlocks the potential of AMD's next\-generation data center platforms. We are seeking a seasoned firmware engineering manager to lead and grow the Data Center BIOS team. This is a leadership opportunity: you will be responsible for building and developing the team, recruiting top BIOS and platform firmware talent, establishing engineering culture and processes, and accelerating the ramp\-up of engineers at all levels. You will set the technical direction for BIOS features and own execution from concept through production, including boot readiness, release milestones, and customer and partner issue resolution. The right candidate brings deep hands\-on expertise in BIOS/UEFI, platform initialization, and x86 architecture and debug, combined with the management maturity to coach engineers, drive cross\-functional alignment, and deliver predictably on complex multi\-quarter programs.**THE PERSON:** We are looking for an accomplished engineering leader who leads by example: someone who can roll up their sleeves on a hard debug problem one moment and run a productive one\-on\-one the next. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of building new teams, developing engineers' technical and professional skills, and fostering a culture of ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement. Critical thinking, clear communication, and the ability to translate complex architectural tradeoffs into actionable engineering priorities are essential.**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:****Team Building \& People Development*** Recruit, hire, and onboard firmware engineers across all experience levels to build a world\-class BIOS development and support team. * Develop and execute structured onboarding and ramp\-up plans that accelerate new engineer productivity, including mentorship programs, AI development, technical deep\-dives, and hands\-on coaching expectations. * Conduct regular one\-on\-ones, performance reviews, and career development planning; identify high\-potential engineers and create growth paths for advancement. * Foster a collaborative, inclusive team culture grounded in technical excellence, psychological safety, and accountability. * Establish team norms, coding standards, firmware review processes, and documentation practices. **Technical Leadership \& Architecture*** Own the Platform BIOS from PreSI to Production until the EOL of the program. * Drive system Firmware requirements from definition, development in emulation and pre\-silicon simulation through first silicon and production; serve as the escalation point for complex, cross\-team debug campaigns. * Collaborate closely with Feature Enabling Team, firmware architects, Debug team, IFWI teams, and platform software engineers to co\-define firmware/hardware interfaces and feature specifications. * Plan product Platform Initialization timeline and work closely with Lead System engineers to meet the program goals in order to deliver FW to external and internal stakeholders. **Program Execution \& Delivery*** Define, track, and communicate team goals, milestone plans, and risk areas to senior leadership and partner teams. * Own the firmware feature roadmap for the program; balance short\-term silicon commitments with long\-term architectural investment. * Drive continuous improvement in firmware quality, test coverage, bring\-up velocity, and release reliability. * Manage cross\-functional dependencies with hardware, software, platform, and validation teams to ensure smooth program execution. **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:*** Experienced in x86 bios, semiconductor firmware, embedded systems, or SOC software engineering, with a focus in an engineering management or tech lead\-manager role. * Proven record of building new engineering teams: hiring, onboarding, and growing engineers from junior to senior level in a fast\-paced semiconductor environment. * Solid understanding of x86 architecture: server business environment. * Track record of mentoring and developing engineers; experience implementing structured onboarding programs, technical training curricula, or engineering ladders. * Excellent cross\-functional collaboration and communication skills; ability to represent firmware perspective in architecture reviews and executive program updates. **ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:*** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.** **\#LI\-LB1** Qualifications: *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third\-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.* *AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available* *here.* *This posting is for an existing vacancy.*

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day\-to\-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top\-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com. As a Senior Backend Engineer you will design, build, and scale the backend systems that enable remote operators to monitor, support, and interact with our autonomous ground support equipment (AGSE) operating in live airport environments. As our autonomous fleet expands across airports, remote assistance becomes a critical component of safe and reliable operations. You'll build the services that connect autonomous vehicles with remote operators, enabling real\-time communication, vehicle monitoring, assistance requests, and operational decision\-making. This is a hands\-on engineering role at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time communication, and autonomous vehicle operations. You'll work closely with autonomy, platform, infrastructure, and operations teams to develop reliable, low\-latency backend services that support an increasingly large fleet of autonomous vehicles. You'll have significant ownership over system architecture, reliability, and scalability, building production systems where performance and availability directly impact real\-world operations. **You Will** ------------ * Design, develop, and maintain backend services powering AeroVect's remote assistance platform for autonomous vehicle operations. * Build reliable, low\-latency communication systems between autonomous vehicles, cloud infrastructure, and remote operators. * Develop APIs and cloud backend services that enable vehicle monitoring, remote assistance requests, operator interactions, and fleet coordination. * Design and implement real\-time data streaming and cloud event\-driven architectures to support vehicle state updates, telemetry, and operational events. * Build scalable systems to manage remote assistance sessions, including request routing, operator assignment, session state, and lifecycle management. * Ensure backend systems are resilient to network interruptions, latency, and intermittent connectivity in real\-world airport environments. * Develop robust mechanisms for authentication, authorization, auditing, and secure communication between vehicles and remote operators. * Build monitoring, logging, and observability capabilities to identify issues and maintain high system reliability. * Collaborate with autonomy and platform engineers to integrate remote assistance capabilities with vehicle software and fleet management systems. * Optimize backend performance, scalability, and fault tolerance as the number of deployed vehicles and remote assistance sessions increases. * Take end\-to\-end ownership of backend services, from system design and implementation through deployment, testing, and production support. **You have** ------------ * 5\+ years of experience in backend software engineering, with a strong track record of designing and operating production\-grade distributed systems. * Strong programming experience in Python, Go, C\+\+, or similar backend languages. * Experience designing and building scalable backend services, APIs, and microservices architectures. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous processing, and fault\-tolerant architectures. * Experience with real\-time communication technologies such as WebSockets, gRPC, or similar protocols. * Hands\-on experience with message brokers and event\-driven systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams, or equivalent technologies. * Experience building and deploying cloud\-native applications, preferably on AWS. * Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, HTTP, connection management, and latency optimization. * Experience designing systems for high availability, observability, and production reliability. * Ability to independently own complex technical projects and make sound architectural decisions in an evolving environment. * Strong communication skills and experience collaborating across software, infrastructure, and product teams. **We Prefer** ------------- * Experience building backend systems for autonomous vehicles, robotics, teleoperations, or remote assistance platforms. * Experience working with vehicle telemetry, fleet management, or real\-time operational monitoring systems. * Knowledge of video streaming technologies such as WebRTC, RTSP, or other low\-latency media protocols. * Experience developing systems that operate across unreliable or bandwidth\-constrained networks. * Familiarity with safety\-critical systems, operational safeguards, and secure remote interactions with physical devices. * Experience with edge\-to\-cloud communication architectures. * Experience building dispatching, scheduling, or resource allocation systems. * Previous experience in a fast\-paced startup environment, building products and infrastructure from the ground up.

As a Senior Data Engineer at AeroVect, you will design, build, and scale the data infrastructure powering our autonomous ground support equipment (AGSE) operations. This is a hands\-on engineering role in a fast\-paced environment where you'll have significant ownership over data architecture, pipeline reliability, and infrastructure scalability. You'll collaborate closely with software, infrastructure, autonomy, and operations teams to build systems that support vehicles operating in live airport environments. **You Will** ------------ * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, process, and store large volumes of autonomous vehicle telemetry, sensor, and operational data. * Develop and operate reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, supporting both near\-real\-time monitoring and historical analysis. * Build and optimize cloud\-based data infrastructure using AWS and modern distributed data processing technologies. * Develop systems to move data reliably from edge devices and on\-premise infrastructure into cloud\-based storage and processing environments. * Design and maintain data models, schemas, and storage architectures that enable efficient querying, analytics, and downstream engineering workflows. * Ensure data quality, consistency, availability, and observability across Lambda, Glue, Redshift, or similar cloud\-native data infrastructure. * Experience designing data architectures, storage solutions, and data models for high\-volume, complex datasets. * Strong environments. * Experience with data lake architectures, GCP BigQuery and AWS Athena. * Experience building data infrastructure supporting machine learning, simulation, or robotics development workflows. * Knowledge of ROS, ROS bags, or autonomous vehicle data formats. * Experience building data platforms from the ground up in a startup or rapidly scaling engineering organization.

jobs.title: Staff Data Platform Engineer, Knowledge Platform
jobs.description: **About Airwallex** ------------------- Airwallex is the AI\-native financial operating system for a real\-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85\+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific. We're co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder\-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. **How you'll make impact** -------------------------- Airwallex is evolving its data and AI platforms into an agent\-ready foundation for company\-wide decision\-making and measurable business impact. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll shape the architecture and technical direction that makes this possible. * Own the strategy, architecture, development, and operation of Airwallex's data and AI platforms, turning data and AI capabilities into measurable business impact. * Identify and solve company\-wide challenges through scalable data platform solutions, influencing technical direction across multiple teams. * Shape the evolution of our data ecosystem into AI agent\-ready infrastructure that supports real\-time performance, analytics, natural\-language querying, and data\-driven decision\-making. * Raise the bar for technical excellence across data platforms by solving complex problems hands\-on, advocating for strong engineering practices, and mentoring engineers and technical leaders. You'll work from our Seattle/San Francisco office three days a week. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- ### **Essentials** * 8\+ years of experience in data platforms or an equivalent combination of professional experience and academic exposure in a quantitative field. * Experience leading company\-wide initiatives across multiple teams or influencing technical roadmap planning. * A track record of collaborating with diverse teams and stakeholders to drive tangible business outcomes. * The ability to balance execution and velocity with in\-depth research, statistical understanding, and scalable system design. * Experience mentoring and investing in the development of scientists, engineers, and peers. * Technical leadership experience across significant data platform projects, including ETL frameworks, metrics stores, infrastructure management, and data security. * Experience building, deploying, and maintaining reliable data pipelines across multiple geographies and at scale. * Familiarity with workflow or orchestration frameworks such as Airflow and dbt. ### **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience designing data processing patterns for a modern lakehouse architecture. * Experience designing and developing standard framework modules, high\-performance services, and client libraries for big data. * Experience with technologies such as GCP, Databricks, BigQuery, Dataproc, Kafka, Kubernetes, Spark, Dataflow, Google Cloud Storage, and Airflow. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor communication for leadership, users, and company\-wide audiences. * Ability to rapidly evaluate technologies and run proofs of concept to inform architecture decisions. * Experience thriving in a complex environment. **You'll thrive here if** ------------------------- * You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. * You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. * You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. * You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability. * You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA. **Learn more about your team** ------------------------------ The Knowledge Platform sits at the foundation of Airwallex’s Data and AI strategy. We are evolving traditional data infrastructure into knowledge infrastructure—turning structured and unstructured information into trusted, reusable context that helps people and AI systems make better decisions and take action. You’ll build the platform end to end, from core technologies such as Databricks, Clickhouse, Spark, and Kafka to real\-time analytics, knowledge retrieval and indexing, model infrastructure, agent capabilities, and AI interaction history. You’ll also develop the evaluation, annotation, feedback, governance, permission, and freshness frameworks required to operate AI reliably at global financial scale. Our mission is making this ecosystem truly agent\-ready. That means enabling teams to explore data through natural language, investigate business drivers in real time, and give AI systems secure access to the context and capabilities they need to support decisions and execute workflows. If you want to build the foundation that turns Airwallex’s data into knowledge, knowledge into intelligence, and intelligence into measurable business impact, this is where that work happens. **Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third\-Party Recruiters** -------------------------------------------------------------- *To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.* *Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.* **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Compensation Range: $200K \- $260K

We're growing, modernizing our technology, and investing heavily in AI and automation to build better software, improve business processes, and move faster. We're looking for an experienced developer who is excited about what AI makes possible and is already using it to build real solutions. This isn't a traditional development position. We want someone who can help us rethink how software gets built, take ownership of meaningful projects, and help our entire Technology team become more effective. **Location:** This is an on\-site position based in Sioux Falls, SD. Local candidates are preferred, but we're open to candidates willing to relocate for the right opportunity. **What You'll Do** * Build and enhance internal applications, customer\-facing platforms, and business automation using **Python/Django, .NET/C\#, SQL, and modern web technologies**. * Use **AI\-assisted development tools** such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, or similar tools as part of your everyday workflow. * Identify opportunities to automate repetitive business processes, integrations, testing, and development tasks. * Build reliable integrations with third\-party APIs, internal systems, and cloud services. * Help establish better AI development practices, including reusable instructions, documentation, automated testing, and code reviews. * Work closely with other developers, sharing techniques and helping the team adopt more efficient development approaches. * Take projects from concept to working software, balancing speed with security, reliability, and maintainability. * Explore emerging AI capabilities, including agents and workflow automation, and apply them where they provide real business value. **What Makes You a Fit** * **4\+ years of professional software development experience**, or equivalent demonstrated ability. * Strong programming fundamentals and experience delivering production applications. * **Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools to build, debug, test, or maintain real software.** We want to hear what you've built and how AI changed your workflow. * Experience with Python, C\#, TypeScript, or similar languages. jobs.title: Senior Detection Engineer - Cloud
jobs.description: At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. **Job Description** The Senior Detection Content Engineer (Cloud) is the technical authority for cloud detection content in Detection and Response Engineering. You own coverage of attacks against Azure and AWS control planes, containers and Kubernetes, and cloud\-hosted AI services, using industry leading Cloud Detection and Response Platforms. You turn posture findings and control plane logs into detections of real attacker behavior, including lateral movement using cloud identities and abuse of LLM APIs. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Detection Engineering Manager.**Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own cloud coverage strategy against Allstate's threat profile, with emphasis on control plane abuse, privilege escalation through roles and policies, persistence via access keys and service principals, and data access from storage. * Design detections across industry standard sources, including but not limited to Azure Activity, AWS CloudTrail, GuardDuty and Kubernetes audit logs. * Build detections for emerging cloud and AI risks: LLM abuse via API, shadow AI usage and prompt or key misuse in AI services. * Maintain cloud Knowledge Objects that feed downstream detections, enrichments and contextualization: account and subscription inventories, sanctioned service lists, privileged role watchlists and cloud investigation context files. * Work with Automation Engineers on key revocation, role removal and workload isolation workflows. * Drive cloud logging requirements (for example data events, Kubernetes audit levels) with Pipeline Engineers and cloud platform owners. * Assist in driving the Detection Standard for the Cloud domain: reusable detection patterns, templates and the Definition of Done, consistent with the team\-wide standard. * Set tuning standards, fidelity thresholds and suppression governance for domain content. Approve tuning and redesign recommendations. * Run the lifecycle review for domain content and present retirement recommendations, confirming no coverage gap is created. * Own and develop the Cloud domain's agentic content development workflow (context files, skills and agents), with human review before anything reaches production. * Final technical reviewer for high and critical severity Cloud domain content. Coach and develop Junior and Mid\-Level engineers, and act as secondary Subject Matter Expert (SME) cover for at least one other domain. **Key Requirements** -------------------- * 7\+ years in security engineering, detection engineering, SOC or incident response, with at least 2 years at a senior or lead level. * Significant experience using industry standard querying languages, such as Kusto Query Language (KQL) and CrowdStrike Query Language (CQL). * Experience using Microsoft Security Suite, Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, and E5 Logging Sources. * Proven delivery of detection\-as\-code in Git (branching, pull requests, CI/CD). * Deep hands\-on knowledge of Azure and AWS logging (eg; Azure Activity, Entra workload identities, CloudTrail, GuardDuty) and the IAM models behind them. * Strong understanding of cloud attack techniques (MITRE ATT\&CK cloud matrices) and container / Kubernetes attack paths. * Experience turning CNAPP or CSPM findings (eg; Wiz, Prisma Cloud or MDC) into actionable detections. **Desired Qualifications** -------------------------- * Cloud security certifications (e.g.; GIAC GCTD, Microsoft SC\-200, SC\-500, AWS Certified Security \- Specialty) or cloud engineering background. * Detection of AI and LLM service abuse. * Infrastructure as code awareness (Terraform, Bicep) for spotting risky changes. * GCP logging and detection experience. * Built agentic workflows with human\-in\-the\-loop controls for security content. * Hands\-on use of AI\-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Codex or similar), including writing custom context, skills or prompts. * Experience writing investigation context for AI SOC agents. * Experience in a large, regulated enterprise (financial services or insurance). \#LI\-JJ1 **Skills** Artificial Intelligence (AI), CI/CD, Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP), Cloud Security, Cyber Incident Response, Kubernetes, Kusto Query Language (KQL), Large Language Models (LLMs), Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Defender, MITRE ATT\&CK Framework, Security Engineering, Security Operations, Threat Detection**Compensation** Compensation offered for this role ranges from $100,000 – 195,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications. identify and resolve data\-quality issues with system owners * Develop decision\-ready analyses, dashboards, and reports that reveal trends, constraints, tradeoffs, and actionable opportunities for engineering and business leaders * Partner with the Lead AI Software Engineer to convert prioritized workflows into well\-scoped automation requirements, representative test cases, and evaluation datasets * Curate and govern NPI knowledge content \- including standards, lessons learned, cost models, and project history \- and coordinate subject\-matter review of AI\-generated outputs * Establish baselines and success metrics for AI\-enabled workflows; ability to reconcile data from multiple sources and explain findings clearly * Experience translating ambiguous business or engineering problems into structured requirements, measurable outcomes, and practical recommendations * Excellent communication, facilitation, and change\-management skills; able to work independently, influence without authority, and travel as needed to support global sites * Ability to travel occasionally, 10\-15% of the time **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with PLM, ERP, MES, demand\-planning, or factory/test data, particularly for NPI costing, capacity, schedule, or readiness workflows * Experience with Power Query or basic scripting in Python or PowerShell, plus practical exposure to AI/LLM\-enabled tools, knowledge management, or evaluation methods Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. jobs.title: Systems Software Developer, CAD Infrastructure
jobs.description: Summary Do you love creating elegant solutions to complex challenges? Do you see the importance in every detail? As part of our Silicon Technologies group, you'll help ensure Apple products and services run seamlessly and efficiently for millions of users. In this hands\-on role, you will partner with Post\-Silicon teams, including Product and Test Engineering (PTE), Digital Custom Group (DCG), Silicon Validation (SiVal), and Design for Test (DFT). You will build and support the automated infrastructure these teams rely on for data management and data processing. You will also help build a new end\-to\-end flow that takes a chip from test pattern to production\-ready test program. Depending on team needs, you may also develop software for memory failure analysis. Description Our North Star is to create, monitor, and maintain high\-quality infrastructure and flows that enable Hardware Technology to produce the chips behind Apple's best products. You will help extend that vision to every silicon team. We are working closely with the Product and Test Engineering (PTE) team to build a full pipeline for test program creation. Our flow is growing beyond test pattern management into end\-to\-end test program creation, with fewer manual handoffs and a faster path from design intent to silicon in the tester. This is a rare chance to grow with a flow that will shape how Apple tests its chips for years to come. Your work will be used by the engineers who bring up every new silicon. You will join an energized, highly motivated CAD team that supports Apple's chip design efforts end to end. Minimum Qualifications * BS in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Experience with Python, Perl, or C\+\+. * Experience working in Linux/Unix environments. Preferred Qualifications * 3\+ years of relevant industry experience. * Experience with post\-silicon infrastructure, such as test programs, test patterns, eFuses, EMAs, or Memory Failure Analysis. * Familiarity with ATE or test program development flows. * Experience with large\-scale systems, from specification and development through deployment. * Solid software engineering practices: agile, code review, automated builds, regression testing, and version control. * Experience with databases, data pipelines, and web or API\-based tools. * Experience supporting internal customers. * Familiarity with applying LLMs or agent\-based automation to engineering workflows. At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. jobs.title: Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Seeking a highly experienced **Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer** to lead the implementation, configuration, governance, and ongoing management of an enterprise Microsoft Azure environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a senior\-level cloud engineer who enjoys designing and maintaining secure, resilient, and scalable cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings extensive hands\-on Azure expertise, strong infrastructure engineering capabilities, and the ability to provide technical leadership across teams. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, thrives on complex technical challenges, and can translate infrastructure strategy into secure, reliable, and business\-focused solutions. What You'll Bring * Extensive hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure services, Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud infrastructure design, security best practices, governance, and operational management. * A strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to manage complex projects from initial design through implementation and delivery. * The ability to guide, mentor, and cross\-train engineers while promoting collaboration and technical excellence. * Strong communication skills, including the ability to present technical recommendations, risks, and strategies to management and executive leadership. Core Responsibilities Cloud Architecture \& Engineering * Design, implement, and maintain secure Azure environments, including air\-gapped and highly restricted cloud tenancies. * Build and maintain hub\-and\-spoke network topologies using Azure Firewall, Application Gateway/WAF, private endpoints, DNS, and routing. * Apply strong networking fundamentals, including OSI model concepts, core network protocols, and network\-level troubleshooting. * Deliver infrastructure solutions using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform and PowerShell, along with CI/CD pipelines. * Develop architecture designs, establish technical standards, and document architectural decisions for review and approval. Security, Identity \& Zero Trust * Implement Zero Trust security principles, least\-privilege access management, and Conditional Access controls. * Establish and enforce security guardrails using Azure Policy, firewall rules, and Network Security Groups (NSGs). * Leverage cloud\-native application protection platforms, including Tenable and Microsoft security tools, to manage vulnerabilities and strengthen security posture. * Collaborate with Security Operations teams to implement security baselines and remediate audit findings. * Support compliance with enterprise and regulatory security requirements. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco or New York (Hybrid) **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission\-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry\-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and power data\-driven applications. Trusted by more than 900 of the world’s leading enterprises, including Datadog, American Express, Expedia, Adobe, Autodesk, Together AI, and more, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io. **About the role** ------------------ The world’s most regulated companies, from global banks to healthcare systems, need a secure and reliable way to orchestrate the flow of mission\-critical data. With 3,600\+ contributors and 30 million downloads a month, Airflow is one of the most active projects in the history of the Apache Software Foundation, and the de facto standard for data orchestration. Astro Private Cloud (APC) lets regulated companies run managed Apache Airflow at scale inside their own infrastructure, meeting their security, compliance and data\-residency requirements. APC customers are among Astronomer’s largest: at one global retailer more than 1,000 data teams use it for workloads that cannot fail, everything from supply chain to payroll. They expect the same experience as our hosted platform, but their environments are locked down, sometimes air\-gapped, and each one differs from the next. So some features need a different architecture to work here, and others exist only in APC. As Staff Product Manager for APC, you’ll own its roadmap end to end. You’ll decide the strategy to make APC the obvious choice for even the most sophisticated open\-source Airflow teams. You’ll work out which capabilities matter most to these customers, how to deliver them in environments we don’t control, and where APC should lead — including new AI pipelines. You’ll work with engineering to ship on dates customers can plan around, spend real time with customer executives, and partner closely with sales and services to keep our biggest accounts growing. And you’ll help build the foundational systems that our products will depend on for years. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Set the vision and roadmap.** Define and drive the strategy for APC, starting with the near\-term goal of reaching feature parity with Astro Hosted. * **Write the requirements.** Specify a complex distributed platform that serves platform administrators, platform engineers, data engineers and AI teams. * **Build alongside engineering.** Work with R\&D from design through release, including the infrastructure decisions that shape the product: Kubernetes, cloud environments, multi\-tenancy and observability. * **Listen to our most strategic customers.** Engage executives and technical leaders on their security, compliance, certification and central\-management needs, and use what you learn to prioritize. * **Balance the few and the many.** Weigh specific customer demands against a committed roadmap that serves the broader customer base. Push back where necessary, and work with forward\-deployed engineers to deliver custom requirements. * **Enable go\-to\-market teams.** Support product marketing and sales with customer\-focused messaging and content. * **Be the voice of APC.** Represent the product externally through conferences, webinars and written content. **What you bring** ------------------ * **Staff\-level product experience.** 8–9 years of product roles at enterprise data or infrastructure companies, with demonstrated experience driving product strategy and delivering impactful outcomes. * **Technical depth.** You can engage as a peer with engineering partners across R\&D. * **Platform knowledge.** Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and the modern data stack. * **Experience with demanding technical users.** You've handled large, complex requests and have the judgment to weigh them against the product's overall roadmap. * **Customer\-facing presence.** You're comfortable with executives and can turn customer input, product data and industry trends into a data\-driven roadmap. * **A bias to action.** A record of delivering the product vision you set across multiple R\&D teams. * **Strong communication.** You work well with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Public voice.** You're comfortable speaking and writing publicly about technical products. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Experience with on\-premise or self\-hosted enterprise software, or with customers in regulated industries such as finance and healthcare * Familiarity with Apache Airflow * Background in security, compliance and certification requirements for enterprise platforms * Experience with open\-source projects and communities *The estimated total compensation for this role ranges from $230,000 \- $300,000, along with an equity component and a comprehensive benefits package. This range is merely an estimate, and the width of the range reflects willingness to consider candidates with broad prior seniority. Actual compensation may deviate from this range based on skills, experience, and qualifications.* \#LI\-Fulltime \#LI\-Hybrid At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** The Security Engineer is the primary technical owner of information security at Buske Lines Inc. and the Company’s point of accountability for its Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP). Reporting to the VP of Technology, this position designs, implements, and independently validates the safeguards protecting the Company’s network, endpoints, identities, data, and cloud services across all operating sites, and demonstrates measurable compliance with the Buske CIS Framework and the cybersecurity reporting requirements of the Company’s private equity sponsor. Several core security platforms are operated by the MSSP rather than by the Company. A defining requirement of this role is therefore the ability to govern security outcomes through contracted reporting and evidence — specifying what the provider must report, auditing what is delivered, and proving it accurate — rather than through direct console administration alone. The position works in close partnership with the Network Engineer on perimeter and infrastructure security, and coordinates with the Director of IT, IT Project Manager, IT Support Specialist, Data Engineer, and Human Resources. This position reports to the VP of Technology, who is responsible for cybersecurity reporting and escalation to the Company’s private equity sponsor. In the absence of the VP of Technology, this position reports and escalates directly to the sponsor. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * **MSSP oversight.** Serve as primary technical liaison to the MSP/MSSP/CSP; own escalation, issue tracking, and quarterly reviews of performance against contracted service levels. * **Security reporting requirements.** Define the security reporting the provider must deliver — content, level of detail, and cadence — and ensure these obligations are contractual and carry forward through any provider transition. * **Audit of provider reporting.** Audit provider\-supplied reporting rather than accept it. Reconcile reported results against Company\-held sources of truth, sample\-test findings against underlying artifacts, and drive every unexplained variance to closure. * **Endpoint protection governance.** Govern the CrowdStrike EDR platform through contracted reporting and evidence; the Company does not hold direct console access. Verify sensor coverage against the asset inventory and Entra ID and Intune records, and review agent health, detection disposition, and all policy and exclusion changes each reporting cycle. * **Identity, email, and device security.** Working with the Director of IT and the IT Support Specialist, administer Microsoft Entra ID P2 conditional access and privileged identity management, Defender for Office 365 Plan 2, Intune compliance baselines, and FortiClient EMS; enforce least privilege and reduce standing administrative access. * **Network and perimeter security.** Partner with the Network Engineer on FortiGate policy design and rule base review, segmentation and DMZ initiatives, remote access validation, FortiManager standardization, and wireless, network access control, and IoT device isolation. * **Vulnerability management.** Set scope, risk\-based remediation priorities, and service levels for the provider\-operated vulnerability and patch management program; audit scan coverage and reported remediation against independent evidence, and drive open findings and exceptions to closure. * **Configuration and asset management.** Govern secure configuration baselines and maintain authoritative hardware and software asset inventories. * **Incident response.** Serve as technical incident commander for security events, leading containment, eradication, recovery, and post\-incident review, and ensuring High and Critical incidents meet the required one\-hour sponsor escalation through the VP of Technology. * **Business continuity.** Support disaster recovery validation, backup integrity testing, and restoration exercises. * **Compliance and audit.** Own the Buske CIS Framework roadmap and evidence library across all eighteen controls; prepare recurring cybersecurity reporting for the VP of Technology for delivery to the private equity sponsor; support audits, cyber insurance questionnaires, and customer security reviews. * **Third\-party risk.** Conduct vendor and third\-party security assessments and maintain the IT risk register. * **Security awareness.** Own security awareness policy and define campaign, training, and escalation requirements for the provider\-administered KnowBe4 program; audit completion and phishing\-failure reporting and drive remedial follow\-through. Support delivery of annual IT security training. * **Employee security communication.** Notify employees of emerging cyber risks — active phishing campaigns, scams, and threats relevant to the Company — in clear, practical terms; provide training on those risks; and serve as the point of contact for employee security questions, following each through to a resolution  n the Company’s artificial intelligence governance program — define acceptable use, data handling, and review requirements for AI tools; assess proposed AI services for security and data exposure risk before adoption; and monitor use across the business. * **Documentation and governance.** Maintain assigned security policies, procedures, and network and data flow documentation, and follow established change management and purchase approval processes. * Perform other duties as assigned by the VP of Technology. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience. * Five or more years in information technology, including at least three years in a dedicated information security role. * Hands\-on production experience with next\-generation firewalls (Fortinet strongly preferred) and Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security administration. * Working knowledge of endpoint detection and response platforms (CrowdStrike preferred) sufficient to interpret, question, and audit provider\-supplied reporting. * Demonstrated experience managing or holding accountable a managed service or managed security service provider. * Working knowledge of a recognized control framework — CIS Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or ISO/IEC 27001 — and of vulnerability management and incident handling. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce audit\-grade documentation and executive\-level reporting, to explain security risks clearly to non\-technical employees, and to work independently in a lean IT organization supporting distributed sites. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Transportation, logistics, warehousing, or third\-party logistics industry experience. * Private equity–backed portfolio company experience with sponsor\-level security reporting obligations. * Experience auditing vendor\-supplied security reporting, and prior participation in an MSP or MSSP transition. * FortiManager and FortiClient EMS administration; scripting proficiency (PowerShell, Python). * Demonstrated practice of tracking emerging threats and security technologies, and familiarity with AI governance or acceptable\-use frameworks. * **Certifications preferred:** CISSP, CISM, GIAC (GSEC or GCIH), CompTIA Security\+ or CySA\+, Microsoft SC\-200 or SC\-300, or Fortinet NSE 4 or above. **WORK ENVIRONMENT AND TRAVEL** This is a hybrid position performed primarily from a home office during standard business hours, with occasional on\-site presence at Company facilities as business needs require. Travel is expected to be minimal, though periodic visits to Buske Lines Inc. operating sites for assessments, deployments, or audit support are possible. After\-hours and weekend availability is required for security incidents, maintenance windows, and cutover events, including participation in an on\-call rotation. The position requires a reliable, private home work environment suitable for handling confidential Company information. Site visits may involve work in warehouse and equipment room environments and occasional handling of computing equipment. **ACKNOWLEDGMENT** I have received, read, and understand this job description. I acknowledge it describes the general nature and level of work assigned to this position and is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Buske Lines Inc. reserves the right to revise this job description at any time. This document does not constitute an employment contract and does not alter the at\-will nature of employment. Pay: Up to $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Experience: * IT: 5 years (Required) * Information security: 3 years (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Springfield, MO 65802
