jobs.title: Engineer - Embedded
jobs.description: ### **Description** Brivo SmartHome connects apartments and rental homes to the cloud. Our gateways are Linux\-based devices installed at each property. They control Z\-Wave door locks, thermostats, leak sensors and switches, and report to our cloud platform over MQTT. As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will help design, develop, test, debug and release the software that runs on thousands of these gateways in the field. Our next\-generation gateway software is written in TypeScript on Node.js and runs on a custom embedded Linux image built with Yocto. You'll write application code on the device, and you'll learn the whole path: from a Yocto build, to a firmware update shipped to the fleet, to diagnosing problems on real gateways at real properties. You'll work with our cloud/backend engineers on the device\-to\-cloud messaging layer, with hardware and QA on validation, and with support teams when devices in the field need investigation. A senior engineer will mentor you and review your work closely.### **What You'll Do** * Spend most of your time writing clean, maintainable, well\-tested TypeScript/Node.js code for the gateway software * Support the full lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, release, over\-the\-air updates and support in the field * Work on device integrations, such as Z\-Wave locks, thermostats and sensors, and on the MQTT messaging that links gateways to the cloud * Help build and maintain our embedded Linux image (Yocto/BitBake), including packaging the Node.js application and its dependencies for ARM hardware * Investigate field issues using device logs (systemd/journald), remote diagnostics and fleet data, and turn what you find into fixes * Write Bash and Python tools for builds, testing, provisioning and diagnostics * Join code reviews, sprint planning and backlog grooming on an Agile team ### **About You** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field * 0–2 years of software experience. Internships, co\-ops, capstone projects and serious personal projects all count. * Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript, including asynchronous programming (Promises, async/await, event\-driven design) * Comfortable on the Linux command line, with some Bash scripting * Basic knowledge of data structures, algorithms and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP) * Familiar with Git * Clear written and spoken communication, and an eagerness to learn * Interest in hardware, IoT and how software behaves on real devices ### **Why work for Brivo?** Why Your Work Matters Innovation drives our vibe, but purpose drives our mission. You will work on essential systems that protect the health, safety, and welfare of people and property worldwide. At Brivo, your voice is heard, your talent is respected, and your contributions have a global impact. * *The Brivo Experience:* We thrive on in\-person collaboration and a "one\-team" atmosphere. We embrace our international presence, leveraging diverse ideas and backgrounds to improve our culture and our products. To keep our global teams connected and inspired, we provide a premium onsite experience featuring communal meals, recurring social events, and fully stocked workspaces—ensuring you have everything you need to stay focused while building the future of security. * *Total Rewards:* We support our people with competitive medical, vision, and dental plans (including company\-offset premiums), a 401k with company match, and an unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to maintain a healthy work\-life balance. Individual compensation packages are based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, training, and market conditions. In addition, Brivonians enjoy a robust benefits and perks package tailored to their work location.### **About Brivo** Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises. As the unified global leaders in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI\-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90\+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real\-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure. With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber\-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com. *Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*

jobs.title: F5 WAF & Bot Defence Consultant
jobs.description: Over 200 F5 WAF devices. A security team under constant attack pressure. Bot defence policies that still need shaping. This is a chance to step into a large financial services environment and put real structure around how it defends its applications. You'll work hands\-on in the platform from day one. The team needs someone who can tune policies, read live traffic, and help the people around them get better at doing the same. **What you'll own** You'll own WAF policy tuning across a large BIG\-IP ASM and Advanced WAF estate, cutting false positives and closing gaps based on what you see in the traffic. You'll manage attack signature updates and lead the review, refinement and rollout of bot defence policies. You'll support cloud\-delivered WAF through F5 Distributed Cloud across regional and customer edge deployments. You'll also work alongside security analysts and application owners to get policies into production, and coach the in\-house team so the improvements stick after you leave. Success looks like a calmer operation: cleaner policies, a maturing bot defence posture, and a team that is more confident running the platform on its own. **The details** Location: Denver, fully onsite Contract: 6 months, hourly rate Start: Late November Right to work in the UK required If you've spent your career tuning F5 WAF policies and want to put that experience to work where it counts, apply today. **Requirements** Recent, hands\-on experience operating F5 ASM or Advanced WAF in production at scale Strong policy tuning skills and confidence analysing traffic and attack data Practical experience building and refining F5 bot defence policies The ability to explain your recommendations clearly to application teams and engineers Exposure to F5 Distributed Cloud (XC) WAAP and experience in a regulated environment such as banking would be a strong plus. **Benefits** You'll do focused, high\-visibility work in an environment where your expertise is genuinely needed. You'll shape how a major security operation approaches bot defence, not just keep the lights on. It's a six\-month engagement with an immediate start, so you can make a visible difference quickly.

This position is responsible for driving DevOps best practices across the software development lifecycle, enabling continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), automating infrastructure management, and improving system reliability, performance, and security. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in cloud and on\-premises environments, infrastructure as code, container orchestration, and cybersecurity\-focused operations while serving as a technical leader and mentor within the engineering organization. Key Responsibilities:* Provisioning: Design and maintain automated, hands\-off provisioning of physical and virtual hosts, from network boot through a fully configured, compliant system. * Configuration management: Define system state as code, enforce it consistently across environments, and eliminate configuration drift. * CI/CD: Build and maintain pipelines that test, package and deploy both application and infrastructure code; improve speed and reliability of releases. * Workflow automation: Find manual, repetitive operational tasks and replace them with reliable, auditable automation and tooling. * Identity and access: Operate centralized identity services — directory, authentication, certificate authority and access policy — including replication, integration and lifecycle management. * Containers: Build, secure and run containerized workloads, including image builds, registries and runtime management. * Content delivery: Manage internal distribution of software, packages and artifacts — repository mirrors, caching and delivery to hosts across sites. * Security and hardening: Apply and maintain hardening baselines, mandatory access controls, host firewalls and least\-privilege practices; support audit and compliance requirements. * Reliability: Participate in troubleshooting and incident response, lead root\-cause analysis, and fix underlying causes rather than symptoms. * Collaboration and knowledge sharing: Contribute to architecture and engineering standards, share expertise through pairing and design and code reviews, and write the runbooks and design notes the team relies on. Responsibilities: * 10\+ years in systems, infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with a track record of applying DevOps practices: infrastructure as code, version control for everything, peer review, automated testing and continuous delivery. * Experience mentoring other engineers and contributing to team\-wide technical standards and design decisions. * Deep administration experience with enterprise Linux, preferably Red Hat–family distributions. * Hands\-on experience with automated OS provisioning and installation at scale. * Production experience with at least one configuration management tool. * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with a mainstream platform. * Solid scripting and programming skills in Python, plus shell. * Working knowledge of directory services and authentication: LDAP, Kerberos, and PKI/certificate management. * Experience building and running containers. * Practical Linux security experience: mandatory access control, host firewalls, and hardening to a recognized baseline. * Strong troubleshooting skills across OS, network and application layers. * Clear written communication and a habit of documenting work. jobs.title: Senior Data Quality Assurance Engineer, Data Annotation Services
jobs.description: **Career Area:** Technology, Digital and Data**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. ### **Help Build the Future of Caterpillar** At Caterpillar, technology always has a purpose, which is to solve our customers' toughest challenges. Through Cat Technology, we are solving problems by building the intelligence layer that connects machines, data, and people to make jobsites safer, more productive, and more sustainable. By combining deep domain expertise in physical systems with software, connectivity, autonomy, and AI, we deliver solutions that work in the real world, on real jobsites, at global scale. You'll build and deploy against one of the most unique data foundations, over 1\.6 million connected assets generating real\-world data daily. These data and platform capabilities are enabling the development of AI models, edge computing architectures, and software systems that scale across fleets, products, and industries. The result will be a new generation of machines that continuously learn, improve, and deliver performance at scale. ### **Be Part of What's Next in Autonomous Construction Sites** Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible, intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites, into reality. Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes of high\-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against. If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You'll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations. Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar. ### **Job Summary:** We are seeking a Senior Data QA Engineer to own the quality of training data used for robotics, autonomy, computer vision, and Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) systems, working within a scrum team. This role combines data quality engineering, test automation, and machine learning to define, measure, and continuously improve the accuracy of annotated and captioned datasets from real\-world heavy equipment and construction environments. The successful candidate will build automated validation frameworks and quality metrics and partner with annotation providers, ML engineers, and platform teams to ensure the data feeding Caterpillar's AI models is accurate, consistent, and trustworthy. This position will also evaluate outputs from automated labeling and captioning technologies such as NVIDIA Cosmos Curator and Cosmos Reason. This is a hands\-on technical role focused on turning complex data quality challenges into scalable, automated, production\-grade quality assurance solutions. ### **What You Will Do:** * Define, document, and maintain annotation guidelines, acceptance criteria, and quality standards for perception and VLA datasets. * Design and execute QA strategies for human, automated, and AI\-assisted labeling and captioning, including sampling plans, audits, and golden\-set validation. * Build automated data validation and test frameworks that verify labeling accuracy, consistency, completeness, schema conformance, and sensor synchronization across camera and LiDAR datasets. * Develop quality metrics, dashboards, and alerting capabilities (precision/recall, IoU, inter\-annotator agreement, defect rates) to track dataset health and drive measurable quality improvements. * Identify, categorize, and root\-cause labeling defects, partnering with annotation vendors, ML engineers, and domain experts to resolve issues and improve quality. * Build and validate quality gates within data pipelines supporting automated labeling, human review, quality validation, and dataset publication. * Evaluate and benchmark auto\-labeling and auto\-captioning platforms such as NVIDIA Cosmos Curator and Cosmos Reason and help develop AI\-driven QA capabilities that scale review processes. * Integrate QA workflows with Caterpillar data systems, external annotation providers, and human\-in\-the\-loop processes while ensuring reliability, traceability, and observability. * Help establish and evolve quality standards for AI training data supporting computer vision, robotics, autonomy, and multimodal AI applications. ### **What You Will Have:** * Bachel and metrics, including precision, recall, F1 score, IoU, mAP, and error analysis. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to communicate findings effectively across technical teams. * 2\+ years of experience working with camera and LiDAR sensor datasets for perception or machine learning applications, including data validation, ground truth generation, and data collection quality processes. * 3\+ years of experience in data annotation and quality assurance supporting autonomous systems or computer vision projects, including development of annotation jobs.title: Technology Team Leader
jobs.description: **Career Area:** Engineering**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. **CATERPILLAR REMANUFACTURING** Do you have a passion for helping customers and supporting a sustainable solution? Since 1973, Cat Reman has helped bring the value at the core of every Cat product back to life. Customers look to us to provide a high\-quality solution that is good for their business \- and promotes sustainability. It's important to us to deliver. Our team is full of industry leaders. Together, following common values, we share a passion for delivering sustainability benefits that help the company contribute to a circular economy. It’s rewarding to work, with an inspiring team, where every contribution matters. **Job Summary** *Caterpillar's Remanufacturing Division is seeking a* ***Technology Team Leader*** *to join the Smart Factory \& Lean Center of Excellence in Mossville, IL. This role will provide technical leadership for the development, integration, and deployment of connected manufacturing technologies across the global Remanufacturing network. The Technology Team Leader will serve as a technical subject matter expert in manufacturing connectivity, industrial data integration, and visualization, helping establish the digital foundation required to improve safety, quality, velocity, and cost.* *The position will partner closely with manufacturing engineering, operations, IT, and facility leadership to connect manufacturing assets, automate the collection of production data, develop scalable visualization solutions, and transform manufacturing information into actionable insights.* *A key focus of this position will be developing and scaling Caterpillar's Device Wise capability across Remanufacturing while ensuring solutions are repeatable, sustainable, and aligned with the broader Modern Manufacturing strategy.* **What You Will Do:** * Identifying, defining, leading implementation of integrated supply chain solutions and performance improvements, including building internal and external alliances to explore opportunities. * Establishing and strengthening effective linkages, partnerships, and best practices with business partners and internal functions. * Investigating and incorporating industry benchmarks, metrics and best practices to develop optimal supply chains for suppliers and/or product sets. * Leads the development and analyzes data and information to identify and prioritize opportunities for improving performance and creating more cost\-effective supply chains, inventory utilization, and business partnerships. **What You Will Have** **Technical Leadership \& DeviceWise Connectivity** * Provide technical leadership for Smart Factory connectivity, data integration, and visualization across Remanufacturing facilities, serving as the escalation point for complex connectivity challenges. * Serve as DeviceWise subject matter expert, developing and deploying solutions that connect PLCs, machine controls, test equipment, sensors, and other manufacturing assets. * Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication across PLCs, industrial networks, databases, and enterprise systems. * Establish technical standards and repeatable approaches that reduce the time and effort needed to connect additional equipment and replicate solutions across facilities. **Data Integration \& Visualization** * Enable reliable flow of manufacturing data from equipment and shop\-floor systems into MES, ERP, SAP/QAD, databases, and visualization platforms. * Support automated collection and visualization of operational metrics including OEE, throughput, downtime, cycle time, quality, yield, and equipment performance. * Partner with manufacturing and operations teams to turn production data into trusted information that enables faster problem solving and decision making. **Innovation \& Future Capability** * Support advanced manufacturing analytics and AI\-enabled use cases that use equipment and process data to predict losses, improve quality, increase asset utilization, and reduce unplanned downtime. * Develop proof\-of\-concept solutions and lead successful concepts through pilot, standardization, and replication. * Stay current on emerging industrial IoT, edge computing, analytics, and automation technologies, recommending solutions based on business value, scalability, and operational requirements. **Project \& Cross\-Functional Leadership** * Lead technical workstreams and projects across multiple facilities and functions, coordinating with manufacturing engineering, operat ies. * The successful candidate will work extensively across manufacturing engineering, operations, IT, Modern Manufacturing, and other technical organizations. **What You Will Get!** Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. jobs.description: Austin, TX **Requisition ID** 2026\-130043 **Category** Engineering \& Software Development **Position type** Regular **Pay range** USD $150,000\.00 \- $158,000\.00 / Year **Application deadline** 2026\-11\-21 **Your opportunity** -------------------- At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us challenge the status quo and transform the finance industry together. We believe in the importance of in\-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s). Schwab Technology Services enables how clients manage their money through innovative, reliable technology. Within Move Money Technology, you’ll help build and evolve the APIs, microservices, and processing capabilities that support critical money\-movement experiences. In this role, you’ll combine hands\-on software development and technical leadership to deliver scalable, resilient solutions using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, batch processing, and event\-driven architecture. You’ll influence design decisions, modernization efforts, engineering standards, and production readiness while solving complex technical problems and improving reliability. You’ll collaborate across Product, Architecture, Quality Assurance, and Agile teams, mentor engineers, and use emerging AI\-enabled development tools responsibly to improve productivity, testing, troubleshooting, and code quality. Your ability to make sound technical decisions, adapt to evolving priorities, and drive shared outcomes will directly contribute to reliable technology experiences for Schwab clients. **What you have** ----------------- **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain high\-performance RESTful APIs and microservices using Java and Spring Boot. * Build RESTful services using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Batch and related frameworks. * Implement API contracts, request validations, business workflows, and integrations with internal and external systems. * Design and implement enterprise\-scale batch processing solutions using Spring Batch. * Build event\-driven solutions supporting customer and transaction lifecycle processing. * Develop reusable libraries, shared services, and integration components to improve platform consistency. * Support modernization initiatives and migration efforts across the Move Money ecosystem. * Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to technical design decisions. * Create comprehensive unit, integration, and automated API tests. Ensure code quality through peer reviews, static analysis, and adherence to coding standards. * Support DevOps and CI/CD practices across GitHub\-based development pipelines. * Utilize AI\-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, and enterprise AI platforms to improve development productivity. Leverage AI for code generation, unit test creation, documentation, code reviews, and troubleshooting. Partner with engineering leadership to identify opportunities for AI\-driven automation across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).* responsible AI practices, governance, and security considerations when using AI tools. * Champion operational resilience by implementing observability, monitoring, logging, and alerting capabilities and fault tolerance into the applications with the objective of shifting left while minimizing operational overhead. Proactively identify risks, establishing mitigation plans, and maintaining documentation and code quality standards. * Contribute to technical roadmaps and engineering best practices. * Participate in performance testing, resiliency testing, and production readiness activities. Drive release process improvements synchronizing team efforts for seamless product releases. Troubleshoot production issues and drive root\-cause analysis. * Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA, and Scrum teams throughout the SDLC. Support PI Planning activities and execution of quarterly commitments. Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, story decomposition, and estimation. * Evaluate and implement AI\-assisted development best practices within the team. Provide mentorship and hands\-on coding support to geographically distributed team. **What you have** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. * 7\+ years of software development experience building enterprise web applications. * Strong proficiency in Java 17\+, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, REST API development, Microservice architecture, SQL and relational databases, Git/GitHub * Experience with API design and development, object\-oriented design and design patterns, and relational database concepts. * Experience developing Enterprise Apis, batch processing solutions * Experience writing automated unit tests using tools such as Jest and NUnit. * Experience working in Agile delivery environments. * Knowledge of CI/CD practices and DevOps methodologies. * Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams. * Experience using AI\-enabled development tools such as GitHub Copilot or similar solutions to improve code quality and productivity. * Independently delivers moderately complex features with minimal oversight. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Open API/Swagger specs, Kafka or event driven architectures * Experience with Financial services or payment platforms is a plus. * Experience with public cloud platforms including AWS (Amazon Web Services) or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Knowledge of messaging technologies such as IBM MQ or RabbitMQ. * Experience working in large\-scale, highly regulated enterprise environments. * Exposure to modern software architecture patterns and distributed systems. In addition to the salary range, this role is eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities. **What’s in it for you** ------------------------ At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis. We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future: * 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan * Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28\-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions * Paid parental leave and family building benefits * Tuition reimbursement * Health, dental, and vision insurance **Eligible Schwabbies receive** ------------------------------- * **Medical, dental and vision benefits** --------------------------------------- * **401(k) and employee stock purchase plans** -------------------------------------------- * **Tuition reimbursement to keep developing your career** -------------------------------------------------------- * **Paid parental leave and adoption/family building benefits** ------------------------------------------------------------- * **Sabbatical leave available after five years of employment** -------------------------------------------------------------

Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation. Our prevention\-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen. This is where innovation meets real\-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems. We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture. What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely. If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI\-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it. **Job Description** We are looking for a passionate Backend Software Developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, investigating real\-world customer scenarios, and building high\-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate is curious, analytical, eager to learn new technologies, and embraces AI\-powered tools to enhance development, investigation, and problem\-solving. As part of the Management CFG team, you will investigate complex software issues reported from production environments, develop code fixes, and contribute to the stability, reliability, and evolution of Check Point's Security Management platform. You will work closely with Technical Support, QA, and other R\&D teams to deliver robust solutions that directly impact our customers. **Major Responsibilities** * Investigate complex customer\-reported software issues from analysis through implementation and validation. * Work with different backend technologies, primarily Java, alongside Spring, PostgreSQL, and also C\+\+. * Collaborate with Technical Support and cross\-functional R\&D teams to troubleshoot production issues and improve product quality. * Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing within the team. * Leverage AI\-powered development tools to improve productivity, accelerate investigations, and enhance software quality. * Willingness to provide customer support coverage during weekends, when needed, to help ensure continuous service across time zones. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of backend software development experience. * Strong Java development skills (advantage). * Experience with Spring/Spring Boot and relational databases such as PostgreSQL (advantage). * Solid understanding of Linux environments, debugging, and troubleshooting complex software systems. * Experience with software design, object\-oriented programming, and clean coding practices. * Familiarity with networking concepts or information security is an advantage. * Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across multiple teams. * Curiosity, ownership, and a continuous learning mindset, including the effective use of AI\-assisted development tools. * Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship from an employer now or in the future. EOE M/F/Veterans/Disabled The wage range for this position takes into consideration a variety of factors in determining your pay. We'll consider your location, experience, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. A reasonable estimate of the current base wage range for this role is $150,000\-$175,000 In addition to the base compensation, certain roles are eligible for additional compensation, including an annual bonus or sales incentive based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee’s role. These awards are allocated based on individual performance. Benefits/perks listed here may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Check Point Software Technologies and the country/state where you work. US\-based employees gain access to healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan and company match, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, stock awards and an employee stock purchasing plan. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 11/29/2026 Meet the Team The Cisco 8000 Layer 3 Forwarding team develops the IOS XR software that powers packet forwarding on Cisco Silicon One, Cisco’s family of high\-performance networking ASICs. As part of Cisco’s Distributed Systems Engineering (DSE) organization, we build scalable, high\-performance routing platforms for service providers and hyperscale networks, supporting the growing demands of cloud infrastructure and AI/ML workloads. Our work connects routing decisions to hardware forwarding behavior—from programming routes and next hops to optimizing forwarding scale, performance, and reliability. We collaborate closely with routing control plane teams to translate routing information into hardware forwarding entries, and with Cisco’s Silicon One ASIC and SDK engineering teams to program the network processors using their software development kit (SDK). These partnerships put our team at the intersection of routing software and networking hardware. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle, from design and implementation to validation and production troubleshooting. Join a team where your work directly shapes how some of the world’s largest networks move traffic. Impact You are a developer who will design, develop, automate, and execute new hardware or features across complex Network Architectures using C/C\+\+ language. You define and qualify end to end / solution architectures, engage in debugging complex network problems and define solutions. Having worked on network automation, you could demonstrate algorithmic thinking and analytics applications derived from customer use cases. **What you will do:** oContribute to the development and enhancement of Cisco IOS XR software. oPlay a vital role in the innovation and improvement of software solutions for AI/ML, hyperscalers, and service providers. oTake ownership of tasks and features with the ability to quickly acquire new skills. oAddress innovative challenges and resolve complex technical problems. oWork closely with fellow engineers to deliver new functionalities and enhancements to customers. oCollaborate with tools like Microsoft Copilot and Cisco's internal AI/ML solutions to drive development efficiency. oDevelop new features for the software or design fully automated tests. oInvestigate and troubleshoot issues to ensure reliable and effective solutions. oUtilize test tools to maintain high\-quality standards and ensure the software meets rigorous benchmarks. oGain hands\-on experience with various areas of network technologies, such as Programmability and Routing Infrastructure. oBuild expertise in cutting\-edge network technology and develop skills applicable to a wide range of systems. oEnhance the experience and satisfaction of customers by delivering robust, high\-quality software solutions. oEnsure the continuous improvement and innovation of Cisco IOS XR software to meet evolving customer needs. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelors \+ 5 years of related experience OR Masters \+ 3 years of related experience OR PhD \+0 years of related experience. * Experience in all phases of SW development cycle with some exposure to agile development methodologies * Experience programming in C, C\+\+ or Python * Development Experience with Network routing protocols * Experience using AI tools to improve engineering productivity such as optimizing complex routing protocols and reducing latency. Preferred Qualifications * Familiarity with Linux and modern software tools like GDB, VTune, Valgrind, Perf etc. for development and debugging. * Deep understanding of L2/L3 to L7 technologies like OSPF, ISIS, BGP, BFD, MPLS technologies. * Familiarity with VMs and virtualization technologies. * Automation experience with Python, Tcl, REST, Jenkins Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada: The starting salary range posted for this position is $155,000\.00 to $222,600\.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation\*, equity, or benefits. Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job\-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process. U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long\-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time. U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies: * 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non\-exempt employees * 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year\-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco * Non\-exempt employees\*\* receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4\.92 hours per pay period for full\-time employees * Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations) * 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next * Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members * Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer For non\-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies. Employees on sales plans earn performance\-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non\-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota\-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows: * .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota; * 1\.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%; * 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and * Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation. For non\-quota\-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid. The applicable full salary ranges for this position, by specific state, are listed below: **New York City Metro Area:** $155,000\.00 \- $256,000\.00 **Non\-Metro New York state\& Washington state:** $138,100\.00 \- $227,900\.00 * For quota\-based sales roles on Cisco’s sales plan, the ranges provided in this posting include base pay and sales target incentive compensation combined. \*\* Employees in Illinois, whether exempt or non\-exempt, will participate in a unique time off program to meet local requirements.

jobs.description: **About Crunchyroll** --------------------- Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super\-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200\+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in\-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love. Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime! **About the role** ------------------ As a Software Engineer III on the Mobile Monetization team, you will contribute to the improvement of end\-to\-end monetization experiences on Crunchyroll’s Apple apps. Our goal is to increase subscription and add\-on revenue while preserving fan trust and product quality. You will take ownership of key features and improvements, ensuring high\-quality code, performance, and user experience. You'll collaborate with Engineering, Product, Design, and Program Management to deliver scalable and reliable solutions that delight millions of anime fans. Contribute to the design and implementation of iOS and tvOS features that enhance our streaming apps across supported platforms. * Work with engineers, product managers and project managers to implement new features across Crunchyroll's iOS and Apple TV app. * Coordinate with the engineering manager on technical designs and decisions. * Coordinate with multiple teams and manage dependencies where applicable. * Ensure that team tasks are completed promptly. * Ensure good code quality by doing rigorous code reviews and maintaining good code coverage on tests. * Work with the engineering manager to develop a comprehensive testing pyramid. * Collaborates with fellow engineers to level up their skills. In the role of Software Engineer III, Apple, you will report to the Engineering Manager, Mobile Monetization. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, working from our SF office three days a week on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays. **About You** ------------- * 5\+ years of experience in software development with a background in Swift/SwiftUI. * Record of success with applications, games and/or utilities for iOS/iPadOS. * Familiarity with architecture patterns such as MVVM (Model\-View\-View Model) and experience implementing them in iOS applications. * Hands\-on experience with automated testing frameworks such as XCTest or Quick/Nimble, and a commitment to writing tests for all code changes. * Quality first mindset: Demonstrates a strong commitment to code quality, reliability, and maintainability in all aspects of software development. * Experience with development for memory and performance\-limited devices in a multi\-threaded environment. * Cross\-collaborative experience and result and delivery oriented. * Experience with RESTful APIs and networking protocols. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). Bonus points: * Experience with video streaming application development in iOS/tvOS. * Experience migrating to newer technologies in the iOS world (e.g. UIKit to SwiftUI). * Working experience with tvOS applications. * Experience in asynchronous programming (async/await, Combine, RxSwift). **About the Team** ------------------ The Mobile Monetization team owns end\-to\-end monetization experiences on Crunchyroll’s Android and Apple apps. Our goal is to increase subscription and add\-on revenue while preserving fan trust and product quality. This is aligned to Crunchyroll’s broader team mission that delivers content to delight and engage our audiences, partners and team members. We embody Crunchyroll's collaborative spirit, and work with multiple teams to engineer scalable solutions that can be shared across all client platforms. **Why you will love working at Crunchyroll** -------------------------------------------- In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks: * Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually. * Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self. * Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance * Health Saving Account HSA program * Health care and dependent care FSA * 401(k) plan, with employer match * Employer paid commuter benefit * Support program for new parents * Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly! \#LifeAtCrunchyroll \#LI\-Hybrid The Pay Range for this position is listed. Actual pay will vary based on factors including, but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Crunchyroll’s Total Rewards offerings for employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, employer matched retirement savings, time\-off programs, and progressive health benefits and perks. Pay Transparency \- San Francisco, CA $169,000 \- $205,000 USD ### **About our Values** We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value * Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves. * Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding. * Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress. * Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others. ### **Our commitment to diversity and inclusion** Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity \& inclusion. Whether a project calls for navigating stringent codes, balancing budget and schedule, solving an unusual technical problem, or creating a landmark structural system, we connect the right people and ideas to develop solutions that serve our clients and communities. **Position Summary** As a **Designer**, you will contribute to the planning, analysis, and design of structural engineering projects alongside experienced engineers and project managers. Your work will include engineering analyses, contract documents, and project deliverables, with exposure to client collaborations, site visits, and multidisciplinary team delivery of construction projects. This role provides a strong technical foundation through meaningful project work, mentorship, candid feedback, and purposeful professional development. **What You'll Do** * **Structural Analysis \& Design**: Perform structural analysis and design tasks under the guidance of licensed engineers. Apply engineering principles and sound engineering judgment to develop safe, effective structural solutions and contract deliverables that meet the governing building codes. * **Project Delivery \& Quality:** Produce accurate, organized, and high\-quality work that reflects Degenkolb's standards. Build an understanding of project objectives, scope, budget, and schedule; manage assigned work; and communicate progress, questions, and potential issues early. * **Client \& Team Collaboration:** Build trusted relationships with project teams and clients by participating in meetings, supporting client communications, preparing technical documentation, and communicating clearly and professionally in writing and conversation. * **Project Site Experience:** Participate in site visits with experienced engineers to observe existing conditions and construction activities, document field observations, and connect design decisions with how structures are built and perform in the real world. * **Professional Growth \& Development:** Expand your technical knowledge and professional skills through project experience, mentorship, feedback, purposeful learning, challenging assignments, and participation in professional organizations while progressing toward PE licensure. * **Ownership \& Contribution:** Take responsibility for your commitments, seek context when needed, share ideas, and contribute to the collective success of your project teams, office, and firm. **Minimum Requirements** * **Education:** A master's degree in structural engineering is strongly preferred. * **Alternative Path:** Exceptional candidates with a bachelor's degree in civil engineering and one to two years of highly technical structural design experience will be strated through advanced graduate coursework or verified professional project experience in: 1\. Advanced steel design 2\. Advanced reinforced concrete design 3\. Advanced structural analysis 4\. Structural dynamics 5\. Earthquake engineering (West Coast offices) * Undergraduate GPA of 3\.40 or higher; strong academic performance in graduate coursework is expected, where applicable * Unofficial undergraduate and graduate transcripts, as applicable * Professional written and verbal communication skills * Current authorization to work in the United States for any employer **Desired Qualifications** * Passing score on the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam * Additional coursework or experience in wood design, prestressed concrete, or finite element analysis, or * Additional coursework or experience in nonlinear analysis for West Coast office locations * Familiarity with engineering software and tools such as AutoCAD, Tekla, RISA, RAM, Revit, Excel, Mathcad, SAP2000, ETABS, Python, or similar platforms * Demonstrated leadership potential, initiative, and commitment to collaborative learning * Experience in seismic analysis and the design of buildings (West Coast offices) **Compensation \& Benefits** The annual salary range for this position across our offices generally falls between **$87,000 and $115,000**. This range is a good\-faith estimate provided pursuant to applicable pay transparency laws. Actual compensation will be based on factors including work location, company geographic differentials, education, experience, and candidate qualifications. They include: * Health and life insurance * Commuter benefits * 401(k) with company profit\-sharing contribution * Employee ownership through a privately held stock plan * Financial support for professional activities and development * Company holidays, a generous paid time off program, and paid parental leave **Our Culture** Degenkolb is a place where technical rigor and human connection strengthen one another. jobs.title: Senior Power Generation Engineer
jobs.description: DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission\-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high\-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience. **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.** **Position Title:** Senior Power Generation Engineer**Position Location:** Remote \- work virtually from anywhere in the United States **Salary** DLB recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out\-compete those ranges for well\-qualified candidates. **Job Summary** DLB is building a team to provide complete engineering design services for multi\-building data center campuses, from 100 MW to 1 GW\+, with fully islanded or behind\-the\-meter generation. The Senior Power Generation Engineer serves as project or lead engineer for the generation side of these campuses, defining scope and driving engineering from concept through detailed design. The focus is gas\-fired generation and its electrical and controls systems. This role works with a high degree of independence, receives general direction on new projects, may coordinate other personnel, and operates in line with organizational goals and values. **Essential Functions** **Scope \& Strategy (40%)** * Define technical scope for generation facilities, including generation sizing, redundancy, and phasing against campus load growth * Develop gas supply needs and strategy, including fuel demand, pipeline and metering interfaces, and on\-site gas handling * Lead conceptual design of large generators, primarily combined cycle and RICE engine plants, and evaluate other types as needed * Coordinate electrical and mechanical systems across generation, balance of plant, and campus electrical distribution * Provide technical input to PPA structuring for islanded and behind\-the\-meter generation * Provide input to proposals, including scope definition and validation of schedule and cost * Work with management to develop the engineering resource strategy, including internal design versus subcontracting * Serve as technical point of contact for generation, documenting engineering decisions and managing technical risk **Design \& Engineering (25%)** * Prepare generation conceptual design packages, including plant arrangement, equipment selection, and single\-line diagrams * Develop sequences of events and operation, including start, synchronization, load sharing, islanding, black start, and shutdown * Define generation\-to\-data\-center load management, including load profiles, step response, and AI\-load variability * Develop generation controls concepts, including the plant controller and integration with campus power management and SCADA * Design generation electrical systems, including generator step\-up, auxiliary power, switchgear, and grounding, and coordinate protection with P\&C engineers * Write equipment specifications and coordinate with OEMs (gas turbine and RICE engine) and other vendors on selection, technical requirements, and design interfaces for generators, switchgear, controls, and balance\-of\-plant systems * Prepare drawings in AutoCAD and Revit * Support project delivery as engineer of record, or in support of the EOR **Project Execution (25%)** * Coordinate with internal teams and utilities to shape project approach and execute engineering of generation and data center campuses * Work with clients to understand requirements and ensure satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle * Review deliverables from internal teams, vendors, and subcontractors for technical quality and consistency with scope * Identify scope changes and develop strategies to control cost and schedule deviations * Support construction, commissioning, and energization through RFIs and field engineering * Lead technical reviews, design meetings, and client presentations, and prepare design and construction documents **Reporting (10%)** * Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders * Update and maintain shop drawing and RFI log * Manage personal hours using company tools **Technology \& AI\-Enabled Efficiency*** Identify opportunities to use AI\-enabled and digital tools to improve efficiency, in line with DLB data security standards **Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget** *Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned* **Position Requirements (Advanced level for all the following)** * Detailed knowledge of combined cycle and RICE engine generation, including sizing, performance, fuel systems, and operating characteristics * Strong understanding of generation controls, including plant control, governor and voltage regulation, synchronization, load Strong written and verbal communication skills, including serving as a client\-facing point of contact; ability to plan and delegate the work of others * Ability to work independently in a remote environment and follow company and site safety requirements **Travel Requirements** * Up to 20%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states * Travel means leaving home for business, including client sites, internal meetings, business development, and industry conferences. **Education / Experience** **Required*** Bachelor of Science in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (or closely related discipline) * 8\+ years of progressive power generation or power plant engineering experience * Conceptual design of large generation plants (100 MW\+), primarily gas\-fired, ideally across multiple generator types * Hands\-on experience with islanded or behind\-the\-meter generation for large, high\-availability loads, including controls and load\-step response * Development of sequences of events for generation facilities * Experience estimating or validating cost and schedule for generation projects, with working knowledge of equipment lead times and pricing * Experience evaluating OEM proposals and specifying generation equipment * Basic understanding of associated electrical infrastructure, including medium\-voltage distribution, switchgear, grounding, protection, and interconnection * Experience coordinating multidisciplinary design teams and working with owners, utilities, or owner engineering teams on utility, data center, or industrial projects **Preferred / Strong Plus*** Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred, but not mandatory * Gas supply and pipeline interface for generation facilities * Generation controls integration, including plant controllers and power management systems * Engineering resource and subcontracting strategy for large projects **Benefits** DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include * Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO\-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option) * Flex spending accounts (FSA) * Dental and vision plans * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26 * 401k with company match and self\-directed brokerage account option * PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year * Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents * Short and long\-term disability, AD\&D coverage * Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance * Paid parental leave after one year of employment CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non\-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E\-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce. Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award\-winning team! **NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:** DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to DLB in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where DLB has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of DLB and DLB will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

jobs.description: If you are a current DSV employee and interested in a position in another country,please contact your Human Resource representative to discuss the process and requirements of applying. Job area: Logistics **FRAUD ALERT: Please note that DSV will never request a chat interview or solicit funds from applicants or employees through its interviewing and hiring process. Today, we add value to our customers' entire supply chain by transporting, storing, packaging, re\-packaging, processing and clearing all types of goods. Additionally, this role will actively support the creation, validation, and use of tools and standards for both the department and DSV organization. All activities shall be completed with strict DSV organizational requirements for Safety, Quality, and Financial responsibility. **\*\* This role can be based at a DSV location; Aurora, IL; Port Reading, NJ; Lancaster, TX; or Virtual USA residing near a mojor airport \*\*** Travel expectation is in the 50% range. Internal and external partnership and collaboration. Engineering focus can be on either new or existing distribution operations. Successful candidates will be natural self\-starters. \*\* Expected travel range: 50% \*\* **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Lead the design, development, and implementation of warehouse and distribution center solutions including facility layouts, operational processes, and equipment selection. * Analyze and optimize operational workflows, including inbound, putaway, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, and value\-added services (VAS), to ensure efficient and scalable execution. * Define facility, process, and equipment requirements and gain stakeholder alignment on final solution designs. * Support design and implementation of warehouse technologies and distribution systems, including WMS or other related operational platforms, to maximize performance and operational effectiveness. * Develop detailed implementation plans, schedules, and task lists to support successful project delivery in partnership with Project Managers and cross\-functional stakeholders. * Identify, evaluate, and procure capital equipment and other required assets to support operational start\-up and long\-term business objectives. * Manage vendor, supplier, contractor, and customer relationships throughout project execution. * Support the implementation and integration of automation and material handling solutions within distribution and fulfillment operations as a part of the overall engineering design. * Ensure all solutions comply with applicable customer requirements, safety standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. * Coordinate multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while proactively identif tion, holistic detailed design, procurement, and vendor management for project implementations. **Supervisory Responsibilities** * As Assigned: management of vendors completing work tasks for the project. * May Be: identified to support onboarding of peers. **Other Physical Requirements:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee uses his/her hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, or crouch; talk or hear. The employee uses computer and telephone equipment. Specific vision requirements of this job include close vision and distance vision. Must be able to lift up to 40 lbs. while following proper lifting procedures. Must be able to stand on feet for up to 8 hours per day. **WORK ENVIRONMENT**While performing the duties of this job, the employee rarely is exposed to fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. The physical demands and work environment characteristics described above are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Reasonable Accommodations Statement**To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For this position, the expected base pay range is $103,000\.00 – $128,000\.00 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on job\-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, and geographic location, in accordance with applicable laws and company policy. Information regarding DSV’s benefits offerings, including eligibility, coverage options, and plan details, is available through the DSV Benefits Showcase. We move careers, ambitions and opportunities. With close to 150,000 colleagues in over 90 countries, we are the global leader in transport and logistics, and it is our people who bring our services and solutions to life every day. From frontline operations to business functions, every role contributes to keeping supply chains flowing and societies running. Here, you are trusted to take ownership, act on your ideas and make decisions that create real impact. It is a place where people, careers and ideas keep moving forward. We value transparency in how we communicate and collaborate, and we win together by supporting each other, challenging each other and delivering results as a team. **Start here. Go anywhere** This is our promise of movement. A promise that your work matters, your contribution counts, and your career can move as far as your ambition takes it. If you are looking to make an impact, grow your career and be part of something bigger, DSV is the place to be. Visit dsv.com \#StartHereGoAnywhere \#LifeAtDSV

jobs.title: Computational Materials Scientist, DeepMind
jobs.description: Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Material Science, Technical Education, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience in Quantum Mechanics. * Experience in Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning. * Experience using computational packages like VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO, or similar. * Research experience with materials relevant to technology development. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * PhD in Computational Materials Science, Solid\-State Chemistry, Condensed Matter Physics, or a related field. * Demonstrated ability to manage and execute computational research tasks effectively, from simulation setup to data analysis and communication. **About the job** ----------------- As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large\-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real\-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $147000 \- $210000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Execute and analyze advanced computational simulations (e.g., DFT, DFPT, MD, lattice models) with a focus on technologically important properties of materials such as electronic, magnetic or optical properties etc. * Contribute to the design and execution of computational screening campaigns to identify and optimize novel materials with desired properties. * Utilize and help refine state\-of\-the\-art computational tools and automated, high\-throughput workflows on our large\-scale compute infrastructure. * Ensure the generation of high\-quality, reproducible computational data from your simulations. Contribute to structuring and curating simulation databases to train next\-generation AI models. * Work closely with AI researchers and software engineers to run scalable simulation pipelines based on AI\-generated hypotheses and to help troubleshoot the simulation\-to\-reality gap. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Human-AI Interaction and Simulation, DeepMind
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cognitive Science, Computational Social Science, Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), or a related quantitative STEM discipline, or equivalent practical research experience. * One or more first\-author peer\-reviewed scientific publications at academic venues (e.g., CHI, UIST, CSCW, NeurIPS, ICML) or public preprint repositories. * Experience modeling and predicting human behavior when using interactive systems. * Experience with core research methodologies, Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), and User Interface (UI) design. * Experience with one or more of the following: computational cognitive modeling, simulated user co\-pilots, human\-agent collaboration, or Generative AI. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 1 year of experience initiating, scoping, and executing independent research agendas or leading collaborative scientific projects in human\-AI systems. * Experience contributing to highly cited seminal papers, widely adopted open\-source research frameworks, or recognized international scientific awards and fellowships. * Experience in PAIR's core strategic focus areas: interactive code or music synthesis, LLM steerability, developer tools, Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), and simulated human behavior alignment. * Experience with interdisciplinary research bridging cognitive science, computer science, machine learning, and human\-computer interaction (HCI). * Experience building novel user interfaces, visualization tools, or sandbox environments to inspect, simulate, and evaluate human\-agent interactions. **About the job** ----------------- The People and AI Research (PAIR) team conducts foundational research to make human\-AI partnerships productive, enjoyable, and fair. Based in Cambridge, MA, our multidisciplinary team of computer scientists, research engineers, social scientists, and designers invents novel interaction paradigms and develops open\-source tools that shape how people interact with intelligent systems. As a Research Scientist in Human\-AI Interaction and Simulation, you will develop computational, cognitive, and statistical models of human behavior to understand, predict, and optimize how people interact with advanced AI systems. Generative models, multimodal assistants, and autonomous agents are transforming interactive computing. Designing effective human\-AI partnerships requires models of human cognitive limits, trust dynamics, steerability, and collaboration patterns. In this role, you will design empirical user studies, build predictive simulations of user interaction, and translate behavioral insights into architectural and UX improvements across Google DeepMind's frontier models. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $147000 \- $210000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop, validate, and land models of human behavior in the context of human\-AI interactions, translating complex behavioral insights into actionable improvements for frontier AI models, interactive tools, and user interfaces. * Focus on model integration and applied product impact across Google DeepMind's systems, pivoting focus from academic publishing to direct, applied contributions to frontier models. * Conduct empirical experiments, build interactive research prototypes, and run simulations to evaluate human\-agent collaboration, validate hypotheses, and refine research methodologies. * Define data structures, simulation frameworks, experimental designs, and evaluation metrics for research solution development, establishing clear execution timelines and resource needs. * Identify emerging research areas through internal and external collaborations, helping develop long\-term strategies to expand Google DeepMind’s applied scientific impact.
