jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer (Python)
jobs.description: **About Entrupy** Entrupy is a global technology company whose mission is to protect businesses, borders and consumers from transacting in counterfeit goods. Entrupy has developed a patented technology system which utilizes a combination of AI and computer vision to instantly identify and authenticate high value physical goods. Entrupy's solutions serve business customers including leading luxury brands, retailers, e\-commerce marketplaces and online resellers in over 60 countries. Entrupy is growing quickly with team members based in the US, India, Japan and Brazil. Entrupy's solutions in market: * Entrupy Apparel Authentication * Entrupy Bags \& Leather Goods Authentication * Entrupy Sneaker Authentication * Entrupy Fingerprinting **As we continue to build...** We're seeking curious, growth minded thinkers to help shape our vision, structures and systems; playing a key\-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you're invigorated by our mission, values, and drive to change the world — we'd love to have you apply. **About the Role** Entrupy is seeking a Senior Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer to join our Platform team. You will work alongside other infrastructure engineers, under our Platform Lead, to keep our AWS platform secure, compliant and reliable. Nearly all of our platform and data services are written in Python, and this role sits right where that code meets the infrastructure under it. You will be a strong Python engineer who prefers to spend their time on infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD and production operations. The team has two main goals. The first is security and compliance across our AWS environment, including our SOC 2 program: keeping our infrastructure secure by default, meeting our controls continuously, and having audit evidence ready at all times. The second is a major infrastructure modernization. We are moving our services off AWS Elastic Beanstalk onto Amazon ECS, defining our infrastructure in Terraform / OpenTofu, and making every service build and deploy through automated CI/CD pipelines. Together, we make sure security and compliance are built into that new platform from day one, not bolted on afterwards. Some of the systems you will work with: * Multi\-account AWS infrastructure: networking, IAM, ECS, backups, audit logging and compliance controls * CI/CD, deploy tooling, secrets management, logging, monitoring and alerting * Python backend APIs for our mobile apps, SDKs and dashboards * Public\-facing APIs and webhooks used by partners and enterprise customers * Data pipelines and ingestors that feed analytics, search and reporting * Databases, caches, search and object stores (PostgreSQL/RDS, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenSearch, S3\) The Platform team works closely with the backend, mobile, machine learning and BI teams, and builds the secure, paved road those teams use to ship and run their services. **Employment Type:** Remote **Reports to:** Platform Lead **Location:** Fully remote (US), working East Coast hours **What you'll do:** #### **Security and compliance** * Help run the technical side of our SOC 2 program with the rest of the Platform team. Implement and maintain infrastructure controls, collect and automate audit evidence, fix control failures, and support each audit cycle. * Help enforce least\-privilege access across our AWS accounts: IAM roles and policies, AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO), cross\-account access, GitHub OIDC for CI, and regular access reviews. * Help make sure data is encrypted at rest and in transit across RDS, DynamoDB, S3, EBS and Redis, and help manage certificates, KMS keys and secrets (SOPS, Secrets Manager, SSM). * Contribute to audit logging, threat detection (CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub or similar) and vulnerability management for container images, dependencies and hosts. * Write security and compliance checks into Terraform / OpenTofu and CI, so that new infrastructure is compliant by default and drift is caught automatically. Take part in security incident response and postmortems, and help keep runbooks and policies current. * #### **Infrastructure and CI/CD** * Work with the team to migrate our Python services off Elastic Beanstalk onto Amazon ECS, managed with Terraform / OpenTofu. Plan and run cutovers with zero or minimal downtime, and decommission the legacy environments. * Build and maintain reusable Terraform / OpenTofu modules for ECS services, networking, IAM, databases and observability. Contribute to the team's state management, environment separation (dev / staging / prod) and a safe, peer\-reviewed plan/apply workflow. * Build and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) that test, build, scan, version and deploy every service. Help standardize Docker image builds, ECR storage and promotion between environments. * Help replace hand\-run and script\-based deploys with repeatable, automated, auditable workflows #### **Operations and reliability** * Share responsibility for production operations and on\-ca  OpenTofu experience: writing and structuring modules, managing remote state, importing existing resources, and running IaC safely across multiple environments and accounts. * Production experience running containerized services on Amazon ECS (Fargate and/or EC2 launch types) with ECR, ALB/NLB, Auto Scaling and service discovery. * Broad AWS experience: VPC, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, Lambda, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, CloudFront. * Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred), including security scanning and OIDC\-based deploy credentials. * Experience migrating production workloads from one platform to another (e.g. PaaS to ECS) without disrupting customers. * Experience running production systems: on\-call, incident response, postmortems and database upgrades. * A collaborative working style. You are comfortable sharing ownership, reviewing and being reviewed, and splitting work across a team. * Clear written communication. You document your work and can explain security and infrastructure trade\-offs to engineers, auditors and leadership. * Comfortable working fully remote and asynchronously with a distributed team, during East Coast hours. #### **Preferred experience** * Experience moving services off AWS Elastic Beanstalk (or Heroku or a similar PaaS). * Experience with compliance automation platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata, Secureframe). * Multi\-account AWS setups: AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies, centralized logging. * Policy\-as\-code and IaC security scanning (e.g., Checkov, tfsec / Trivy, OPA / Conftest). * PostgreSQL administration, including blue/green upgrades, connection pooling (RDS Proxy / PgBouncer) and access management. * Familiarity with GDPR and data privacy requirements. * Experience with search systems (OpenSearch / Elasticsearch) and event\-driven pipelines (SQS, SNS, EventBridge, DynamoDB Streams). * Python web frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, Django) and Poetry\-based dependency management. * Fluency with AI development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) for infrastructure and code work. * Previous work on a small platform or infrastructure team in a startup\-like environment. #### **What we offer** * Market competitive and pay equity\-focused compensation structure * Generous time away including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! * Rich medical benefits and insurance coverage * Safe Harbor 401k match * Dedicated mental health support for employees and eligible dependents We have had an incredible run so far and are laying the foundation for a culture that is fast\-paced, entrepreneurial, and rooted in passion, kindness, and positivity. We live by these values – we hire by them, promote them, and celebrate them every day. Please apply if you want to be a part of a collaborative and dynamic team with a passion for working with high\-end luxury brands and cutting\-edge technology, and want to be at the forefront of AI innovation. The starting salary for this role is between $60,000 \- $130,000, depending on skills and experience. We have competitive pay bands for all other countries based on market standards. Individual compensation decisions are based on several factors, including experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. Based on these factors, we expect most of the candidates offered roles at our company to fall within the range. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than the requirements stated in this job description, as posted. If so, the updated salary range will be communicated to you as a candidate. Entrupy embraces a diversity of backgrounds and experiences and provides equal opportunity for all applicants and employees. We are dedicated to building a company that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work (and work environment) will be for everyone.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: The world’s largest organizations rely on Evident to help them protect their business and brand from third\-party risk. Our game\-changing technology \- which enables the secure exchange of risk data like proof of insurance, identity, business registration, and other information \- helps our customers verify that their partners have all of the required credentials to do business. In today’s new remote\-first, ever\-changing regulatory environment, our secure, privacy\-first enterprise platform, accessible via web portal or API, provides a highly scalable and configurable solution to manage communications, storage, decisioning, and ongoing monitoring of credentials. Evident is a VC\-backed technology startup, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. Learn more at evidentid.com.### **Job Description** Evident is hiring a Solutions Engineer to be a technical lead on our high\-value deals. Evident runs the largest verified business network in third\-party risk management, and we’re making the product dramatically smarter with AI. Our customers operate in high\-risk industries \- construction, transportation, local service providers, and more \- where a single unqualified or uninsured partner can mean real losses, safety incidents, or liability. Getting verification right isn’t optional for them. These buyers don’t trust automation until they see it working on their own data, and this role is where that proof happens. You’ll partner with our Account Executives through the sales cycle, owning the technical side of the deal so they can own the relationship. This is a hands\-on role on a small team where you’ll see your impact on revenue directly. The position reports to our CTO and is based in our Atlanta office (hybrid work model with two days in the office and three days remote). ### **Responsibilities** * Design the solution. Map customer workflows to how Evident is configured, and build repeatable configurations and reference architectures. * Prove it on their data. Run proofs of concept and pilots \- take a prospect’s real documents and show the automation working end to end. * Be the technical voice in the deal. Lead conversations on APIs, integrations, data flows, and security reviews with prospect IT and architecture teams. * Scope it. Set realistic expectations so customers go live on solid ground, and hand off cleanly to implementation. * Build the playbook. Create demo environments, sample datasets, and reusable assets, using AI to shrink the time it takes to stand up a proof of concept. * Bring the field back to product. Translate what buyers are asking for into clear input for Product and Engineering. ### **Requirements** * 3\+ years in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or solutions consulting at a B2B SaaS or API\-platform company * Hands\-on technical depth: REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, Postman, and enough Python or JavaScript to build a demo yourself * Range to demo to a CFO in the morning and whiteboard an integration with an engineer in the afternoon * AI\-native \- you use modern AI tools daily to move faster and do more * Comfortable with ambiguity and with building things that don’t exist yet ### **Bonus Points** * Domain experience in risk, compliance, insurance, third\-party risk management, identity verification, or credentialing * Experience selling into construction, transportation, equipment rental, or lending * Forward\-deployed or customer\-embedded engineering experience * A central seat in our largest deals, working directly with the executive team * The ability to shape how we do pre\-sales **Why Evident?*** Our team solves a crucial problem with huge business potential together, and we are able to see exactly how our contribution affects customers! * Competitive pay package, including base pay and stock options * Full medical, dental, vision benefits and 401K * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave to support you and your family * Home internet stipend, virtual events, \& more! * Recently named one of Atlanta's Coolest Companies \& 50 on Fire by Atlanta Inno * Recently named one of the Top 10 Fastest Growing Companies in Atlanta \& one of the Best Places to Work in Atlanta by Atlanta Business Chronicle We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

That work now spans Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) and a growing medical device cybersecurity practice. Now part of Gener8 — a premier engineering and manufacturing partner with a global footprint — we help life science and medical device innovators turn complex concepts into market\-ready realities. **The Role** ------------ This is a project\-starter role. We are looking for a Technical Lead who can take a new client program from a blank page to a running, well\-architected team — and do it inside an FDA\-regulated SDLC. You will own the technical front end of our engagements: sitting with the client to understand what they are really building, shaping the architecture and design, standing up the codebase and the development approach, and writing real code while the team ramps. Our clients are CTOs, VPs of R\&D, and program leaders who need someone who can hold the whiteboard, the design review, and the pull request with equal credibility. You will be that person. You will also set the pace for how we build with AI. We expect our technical leads to use AI\-assisted development, design, and documentation tools daily — and to know how to use them responsibly under design controls. What this is not: a maintenance seat on a mature codebase, or a pure people\-management role removed from the code. **What You’ll Work On** ----------------------- Our programs span the full breadth of regulated software. Any given year you could be starting projects across several of these: * **Full\-lifecycle regulated software development.** Requirements, architecture, implementation, verification and validation, and submission\-ready documentation under IEC 62304 and design controls. * **Productized IP.** Our Application Accelerator — a pre\-validated starter framework with architecture and documentation already verified — and our LIS Connector. You will know these well enough to start a program on them and extend them. * **Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).** Standalone clinical software, including AI/ML\-enabled device software functions and predetermined change control plans. * **Medical device cybersecurity.** Threat modeling, secure architecture, SBOM, vulnerability and patch management, and Section 524B premarket content — designed in from day one, not bolted on. * **Instrument, embedded, and connectivity software.** Control software, interfaces, and device connectivity for analyzers, sequencers, and point\-of\-care systems. * **Cloud, data, and platform engineering.** Regulated cloud architectures, data pipelines, and connected\-diagnostics infrastructure. * **Remediation and modernization.** Legacy system rescue and bringing inherited software into compliance. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Start projects.** Take new programs from kickoff to a running team: frame the technical scope, set up the repository, toolchain, CI/CD, and branching strategy, and establish the development plan. Get to working software early. * **Architect and design.** Own the software architecture and detailed design — decomposition, interfaces, data flows, segregation of software items, and SOUP selection. Make decisions that hold up under verification, cybersecurity review, and an FDA submission. * **Be the technical face to the client.** Lead technical discovery, design reviews, and status conversations with client engineering and R\&D leadership. Translate between what the client asked for and what they actually need, and push back when it matters. * **Write the code.** Stay hands\-on. Build the hard parts, set the coding standards by example, and review pull requests with a sharp eye for quality, testability, and traceability. * **Work inside the regulated SDLC.** Produce and own technical deliverables under IEC 62304 and our QMS — architecture and design documents, risk control implementation, unit and integration test strategy, and traceability — without letting compliance slow the team down. * **Lead with AI.** Use AI\-assisted tools for coding, design exploration, test generation, and documentation every day. Help define how our teams use AI responsibly in a regulated environment — validation of tool output, data handling, and what belongs in the design history file. * **Deliver results.** Own technical delivery against scope, schedule, and budget. Surface risks early, make the call, and land the milestone. * **Hand off and scale.** Once a program is running, build the bench behind you — mentor engineers, document the decisions, and hand off cleanly so you can start the next one. * **Support the win.** Partner with business development on technical discovery, estimates, and proposal content. Your architecture often shapes what gets sold. **What You Bring** ------------------ * **A track record of starting things.** You can point to programs you personally took from concept to a working, architected product — not just ones you joined midstream. * **Experience.** 10\+ years of professional software development, including 4\+ years as a technical lead or architect on client\-facing or multi\-team programs. * **Strong software development skills.** Deep hands\-on expertise in one or more of C\#/.NET, C\+\+, Python, or TypeScript, plus working knowledge of modern web, desktop, embedded, or cloud stacks. Solid grounding in design patterns, testing, CI/CD, and source control discipline. * **Architecture and design depth.** Experience defining architectures for instrument control, connected devices, data platforms, or cloud systems — and documenting them so others can build, verify, and maintain them. * **Regulated\-environment fluency.** Working command of IEC 62304, ISO 14971, ISO 13485, and FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR, and what each means for how software is designed, built, and verified. Familiarity with medical device cybersecurity expectations (threat modeling, SBOM, Section 524B) is a strong plus. * **AI\-enabled.** Daily, practical use of AI coding and productivity tools, with a clear point of view on where they speed delivery and where they need human verification. Experience building AI/ML\-enabled features is a plus. * **Client presence.** Comfortable leading a design review with a client CTO, explaining trade\-offs to non\-engineers, and owning a hard conversation about scope or risk. * **Results orientation.** Self\-directed, organized, and accountable. You measure yourself by what ships. * **Technical foundation.** BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent hands\-on experience considered. * **Travel.** 10–20% to client sites and other Gener8 locations. **What We Offer** ----------------- Competitive base salary and full benefits, with the backing of Gener8’s global engineering and manufacturing footprint behind every program you start. **Why Join Us** --------------- We operate at the intersection of cool science and precision engineering. The software we build ends up inside the instruments that diagnose disease and guide treatment — the work is real, and so are the standards it is held to. Our culture: high autonomy, intellectual rigor, and a healthy dose of wit. We work hard because the software we build matters. * *Gener8 values diversity in our workplace. Our company provides equal opportunity for employment to qualified applicants based on experience and the ability to do the available work, without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex/gender, sexual orientation, national origin, gender identity, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, ancestry, or any other status protected by law. We are committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.We are an Everify Employer.* **Company Benefits:** Health, Dental and Vision insurance; 401(k); Life insurance; STD, LTD; Flexible spending account, Health savings account; Paid time off; Employee discounts, Referral program.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in software development. * 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products. * 3 years of experience with software design and architecture. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. * 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering, BigQuery
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance * Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment * Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance * Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks * Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks * Holidays: 13 paid days per year ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. * 3 years of experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting distributed systems. * Experience in site reliability engineering, system archiecture, and distributed systems. * 3 years of experience leading projects. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering. * Experience designing and running capacity planning, resource management or infrastructure efficiency systems for large\-scale distributed services. * Experience building automation that safely makes production changes (placement, resizing, rollouts) with clear guardrails and observability. * Experience with cluster scheduling, storage systems, or cloud resource economics (quota, allocation versus usage, utilization). Experience applying LLM or agent\-based tooling to operational workflows. * **About the job** ----------------- Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large\-scale, massively distributed, fault\-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally\-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever\-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance. Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large\-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame\-free environment. We promote self\-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow. BigQuery SRE is a global team and keeps Google's serverless data warehouse reliable, efficient and ready to grow. Together with BigQuery dev team, we run one of the largest analytics services in the world. Our 2027 objectives cover four areas: operational excellence and efficiency, managing and reducing service risk, maximizing inventory, and GCP compliance. We want to be known for engineering, not just operations. That means automation and AI\-driven operations to reduce toil, data\-driven capacity decisions, and helping product teams build reliability from the start. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next\-generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Set the technical direction for BigQuery reliability, efficiency, and scalability, translating multi\-team problems into clear objectives to deliver measurable results. * Design and build software and automation, including AI\-driven operations, that reduce toil and make BigQuery's production systems safer, faster to change and more efficient to run. * Identify, quantify, and reduce service risk across BigQuery's distributed systems, including capacity, data integrity, dependencies, and failure modes and drive mitigations to completion. * Improve incident detection and mitigation by participating in on\-call rotations, leading incident responses, and ensuring postmortem action items resolve underlying causes. * Mentor and grow engineers across shards and sites, review designs and code, and represent BigQuery SRE in cross\-organization technical forums. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Productivity (Remote, USA)
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40\+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open\-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation\-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career\-defining opportunity. *This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).* **The Opportunity** ------------------- ### **About our platform** Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low\-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely. The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, SDLC, security and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads. ### **About the Productivity group** We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Productivity group, which owns SDLC tooling, application security and observability, of the resources, systems and workloads used to build and run Grafana Labs products. The group enables product development through the provision of performant and feature\-rich SDLC tooling, governing the use and configuration of that tooling. We are responsible for guiding the product teams in application security good practices, reviewing product changes for security compliance and enabling security functions through self\-service automation. We also own and maintain the internal observability platform, using our own products to give visibility into cloud resource cost, usage and sustainability, and vulnerability management. You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group. We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self\-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen. ### **How we work** Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self\-service platform to do it on. Every engineer is on\-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on\-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ * Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth. * Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity. * Take platform changes from design to fleet\-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them. * Partner with the other Productivity squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours. * Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on\-call, and the ownership model between squads. * Own the  vigate ambiguity in a complex problem space. * Comfort with AI\-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI\-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow. **Bonus Points For** -------------------- * Experience across more than one of the group's areas: SDLC tooling, developer experience, application security, and observability. * Hands\-on depth in cloud infrastructure, SDLC tooling expertise, developer experience and making the right way the easy way, application security, monitoring tooling and alerting. You can challenge a threat model or a system design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to. * Building self\-service infrastructure for application teams. * Running observability for a production platform at scale. * Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure. * You've worked in or on open source, or other community\-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA" In the USA, the base compensation range for this role is $189,374 \- $227,249\. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. \#LI\-Remote * *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range \& benefits at the beginning of the process.* **Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:** * **100% Remote, Global Culture \-** As a remote\-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. * **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high\-growth, ever\-evolving environment. * **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision\-making and regular company\-wide updates. * **Innovation\-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. * **Open Source Roots** – Built on community\-driven values that shape how we work. * **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. * **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. * **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. * **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. * **In\-Person onboarding** \- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. * **Balance is Key** \- We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.* **Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.* *Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.* \#LI\-Remote *For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our* *privacy policy**.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Enablement Engineer, GTM
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- IT **Compensation** ---------------- * $153K – $210\.5K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus *Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in our equity plan and benefits program. Benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.* **Why Harvey** ============== At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. **Role Overview** ================= We're seeking a Senior AI Enablement Engineer to be the dedicated technical partner for Harvey's go\-to\-market organization — Sales, Customer Success, SDR, Legal Engineering, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations. GTM has been Harvey's most enthusiastic adopter of AI: teams have built dozens of skills, plugins, and agents on their own. That energy is an asset, but it has outrun the structure around it. Your job is to turn that energy into a focused set of workflows that GTM teams trust and use every day. This is a hands\-on technical IC role inside BizTech (Business Technology), partnering closely with GTM leaders, GTM Systems, and RevOps. You'll spend your time sitting with sellers, SDRs, and CSMs to understand how they actually work; consolidating and hardening the workflows worth keeping and retiring the ones that aren't; building the connector and MCP integrations those workflows depend on; and giving GTM a fast, clear answer when they want to try something new. The ideal candidate is a senior IC engineer who understands how a revenue team runs — pipeline, deal cycles, quota, account planning, renewals — well enough to earn credibility with a quota\-carrying rep, and who sees making Harvey's GTM team more effective with AI as the actual job. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Bring order to and extend GTM's AI footprint.** Audit the skills, plugins, and agents GTM teams have built; measure what's actually used; consolidate duplicates into well\-maintained versions; retire what isn't earning its place; ship new AI\-powered workflows. * **Be the AI tooling partner of choice for GTM teams.** Embed with Sales, CS, SDR, Legal Engineering, and Partnerships to understand their workflows from the inside — prospecting, call prep, follow\-up, account planning, pricing, renewals — and steer them toward solutions that fit how they work rather than building for its own sake. * **Own the intake for new AI features and experiments.** GTM regularly asks to try new capabilities as they ship. Partner with fellow AI Enablement Engineers to build a lightweight path for requesting, piloting, and evaluating them — success criteria up front, a timebox, and a clear adopt / wait / pass call at the end — so experimentation stays fast without leaving another trail of abandoned tools. * **Own technical governance of GTM skills and plugins.** Define publishing standards, ownership, review, and deprecation rules for the GTM side of the plugin and skill marketplace, and stand up usage and spend monitoring so adoption, cost, and staleness stay visible as adoption scales. * **Own the MCP and connector roadmap for GTM systems.** Harden and extend the integrations GTM workflows depend on — Salesforce, Gong meeting notes and call recording, Gmail and Calendar, Slack, Omni, and internal knowledge sources — with sensible read/write scoping and guardrails around anything that reaches customers or prospects. * **Build reference patterns GTM can extend.** Ship well\-structured templates and examples so GTM builders can create good workflows themselves, within guardrails, without you becoming the bottleneck for every new idea. * **Run AI vendor reviews for GTM tools.** AI sales tools pitch GTM leaders constantly. Partner with Privacy, Security, and Legal to evaluate them against a reusable framework and give a clear build / buy / pilot / pass recommendation. **What You Have** ================= * 5\+ years of software, integration, or GTM engineering experience, with at least 2 years building integrations or automation on top of GTM systems (CRM, sales engagement, conversation intelligence, CPQ, analytics). * A real understanding of how GTM teams work — the sales cycle, pipeline management, account planning, renewals and expansion — ideally from having worked inside or alongside a revenue org. You can talk to a rep about their week, not just their data. * Hands\-on experience with API integration patterns, OAuth and identity, webhook architectures, and the kind of glue work that makes enterprise systems actually talk to each other reliably. * Practical experience with LLM\-based applications and AI tooling — prompt design, agent workflows, retrieval, evaluation, or production integration of model APIs. You don't need to have trained a model; you do need to have shipped something real that depends on one. * Working knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable agent\-tool integration patterns. If you haven't shipped MCP yet, you've at minimum read the spec and built something against it. * A product mindset about internal tools. You measure adoption, talk to your users, and are as comfortable deprecating something as shipping it. * Strong communication and stakeholder\-management instincts with GTM leaders and individual contributors — you can redirect a VP's feature request toward a better solution and keep the relationship, and be the most pragmatic person in an engineering review the same afternoon. * Strong DevOps and operational fundamentals — CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, secrets management, and observability. You treat the integrations and AI tools you ship as production systems: version\-controlled, monitored, and safe to change without breaking the teams that depend on them. * Demonstrated experience applying data governance and security best practices, including to customer data and to agents that take external\-facing actions. * Comfort evaluating third\-party vendors — asking the right questions about data access and flows, reading DPAs, and translating findings into clear go/no\-go recommendations for the business. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, and global environment with significant ambiguity. **Bonus Points:** * Background as a GTM Engineer, RevOps or Sales Ops engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Forward Deployed Engineer — ideally combined with internal tooling work. * Experience at a company where sales and CS teams adopted AI tooling at scale, and first\-hand lessons about what stuck and what didn't. * Hands\-on work with Salesforce (including custom development), sales engagement platforms, CPQ, or conversation intelligence tools, including their APIs or AI\-adjacent extensions. * Familiarity with enterprise iPaaS platforms. * Experience leading change management or enablement for a sales organization. **Compensation** ================ $153,000 \- $210,500 USD ### **Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. jobs.title: Technical Customer Experience Lead
jobs.description: **About Hark** Hark is an artificial intelligence company building advanced, personalized intelligence. One that is proactive, multimodal, and capable of interacting with the world through speech, text, vision, and persistent memory. We're pairing that intelligence with next\-generation hardware to create a universal interface between humans and machines. While today's AI largely operates through chat boxes and decade\-old devices, Hark is focused on what comes next: agentic systems that interact naturally with people and the real world. To get there, we're developing multimodal models and next\-generation AI hardware together \- designed from the ground up as a single, unified interface for a new era of intelligent systems. **About the Team** You'll be the first person our users meet when something matters, and the person who makes sure it never happens twice. As our Technical Customer Experience Lead, you own every customer's success with Hark across our app, our agent, and our devices. You'll solve the hard cases yourself, then use AI and AI coding agents to build the systems that solve the next thousand automatically. You'll sit close to engineering and product, and what you learn from customers will shape what we ship. This is a founding role: you'll define how Hark takes care of people, and eventually build the team that does it. **Responsibilities** * **Own customer outcomes end to end.** Work directly with users, get to the real root cause, and leave them better off than when they reached out. * **Build AI\-powered customer systems.** Design the triage, routing, drafting, knowledge retrieval, and automated resolution that make every answer faster and better than the last. * **Ship your own tools.** Use AI coding agents to build the scripts, integrations, dashboards, and workflows behind customer success, without waiting on engineering. * **Be the technical bridge to engineering.** Reproduce bugs, read logs, and hand engineering clear, actionable reports. * **Turn signal into product.** Spot patterns across customer conversations and turn them into product feedback, help center content, and fixes that prevent the next issue. * **Own the numbers.** Response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction, with a constant loop to improve them. * **Build the function.** The playbook, tooling, escalation paths, and eventually the team, as Hark scales. **Requirements** * **Customer Experience:** 1–5 years in customer experience, customer support, or support operations, ideally at a consumer tech or software company, with hands\-on customer work. * **Genuine Care for Customers:** You care about the person on the other side and take pride in getting them to a real answer. * **AI\-First Mindset:** You use AI to raise the quality and speed of how you help customers, and you can point to ways you've already done it. * **Comfort with AI Coding Agents:** You build what you need with AI coding tools, whether that's a script, an integration, or an internal tool. * **Technical Depth:** You troubleshoot software issues, read logs, and explain technical problems clearly to both users and engineers. * **Strong Communication:** Your writing is clear, warm, and precise, and you adjust your tone for a frustrated customer, an engineer, or a leadership update. **Bonus Qualifications** * Experience building or scaling a customer function at an early\-stage startup. * Experience supporting consumer software and hardware products. * Familiarity with platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, or Front, and their APIs. * Experience with AI or LLM\-powered products. **Compensation** The US base salary range for this full\-time position is between $120,000 \- $170,000 annually. The pay offered for this position may vary based on several individual factors, including job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package may also include additional components and benefits depending on the specific role. This information will be shared if an employment offer is extended.

jobs.title: Mechanical Systems Engineer - Aerospace
jobs.description: Mechanical Systems Engineer Groton, CT 125000\-185000 Job Description We are seeking an experienced Mechanical, Electromechanical, Ocean, or Advanced Manufacturing Engineer to support the development of advanced subsea research and development (R\&D) systems for DARPA, the Office of Naval Research (ONR), and the broader U.S. Navy. This position will focus on the design, development, and integration of complex mechanical systems, components, and structures, taking concepts from initial design through detailed engineering, fabrication, and testing. The successful candidate will balance multidisciplinary system requirements, functional performance, manufacturability, reliability, and lifecycle considerations to deliver innovative engineering solutions for challenging maritime applications. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to next\-generation unmanned undersea technologies, including advanced propulsion systems, innovative manufacturing approaches, and payload integration solutions. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience developing, maturing, and fabricating complex maritime or defense systems while collaborating with engineers, scientists, and mathematicians across multiple technical disciplines. Success in this position requires strong systems engineering judgment, technical independence, and the ability to evaluate competing design considerations to develop effective, integrated system architectures. Candidates should be comfortable working in a dynamic, fast\-paced R\&D environment that emphasizes innovation, technical excellence, and creative problem\-solving. Experience with advanced manufacturing methods, including laser welding, metal additive manufacturing, and the use of specialty materials such as highly alloyed stainless steels, copper\-nickel alloys, and titanium, is particularly relevant. This position offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where technical excellence, initiative, and innovation are valued. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to take ownership of challenging engineering problems and make meaningful contributions to the development of advanced maritime technologies supporting critical national security missions. Job Functions and Responsibilities * Develop and mature innovative mechanical designs, system architectures, and configurations for advanced maritime and subsea systems. * Perform engineering calculations and numerical analyses, including thermal, structural stress, buckling, electromagnetic, and other relevant assessments, to evaluate and validate design performance. * Conduct system\-level trade studies and evaluate design alternatives to balance performance, functionality, cost, weight, size, power, and manufacturability as systems and components mature. * Maintain awareness of system\-level requirements and ensure design solutions satisfy applicable performance and interface requirements through technical analyses, reports, presentations, and supporting documentation. * Identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks associated with novel system architectures, subsystems, operational concepts, and manufacturing approaches. * Generate detailed engineering and fabrication drawings and support manufacturing activities through direct coordination with vendors and fabrication partners. * Perform dimensional and tolerance analyses and establish appropriate Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T) requirements. * Define, document, and maintain critical mechanical and system interfaces through Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and associated engineering drawings. * Design and develop specialized fixtures, tooling, and handling equipment to support assembly, rigging, integration, testing, and demonstrations. * Prepare and support technical design reviews through the development and maintenance of comprehensive Technical Data Packages (TDPs). * Develop assembly, fabrication, and test instructions to support technician\-led manufacturing, integration, and testing activities. * Provide technical guidance, leadership, and mentorship to engineers and technicians, supporting technical development and effective execution of engineering tasks. * Participate in occasional travel to support government program reviews, vendor engagements, manufacturing activities, and system testing events. * Contribute to technical proposals, capture activities, and business development efforts to support new program opportunities. Required Skills and Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electromechanical, Ocean, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with 5\+ years of relevant professional experience. * Demonstrated experience supporting the design, development, and fabrication of complex, multidisciplinary systems. * Ability to work effectively in small, collaborative engineering teams and coordinate technical activities with subcontractors, vendors, and government stakeholders. *   applied mathematicians. * General familiarity with subsea system components and technologies, including sensors, communications systems, actuators, and propulsion systems. * Proficiency with engineering design and analysis tools, including SolidWorks, Product Data Management (PDM) systems, MATLAB, and/or Python. * Experience performing dimensional and tolerance analyses, including SolidWorks TolAnalyst or comparable tools such as CETOL 6, EZtol, or 3DCS. * Experience with advanced manufacturing processes, including CNC machining, laser welding, and metal additive manufacturing. * Functional understanding of electromagnetic and electromechanical components, including motors, transducers, linear actuators, and related technologies. * Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to develop practical engineering solutions to complex technical challenges. Qualifications Required Skills and Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electromechanical, Ocean, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with 5\+ years of relevant professional experience. * Demonstrated experience supporting the design, development, and fabrication of complex, multidisciplinary systems. * Ability to work effectively in small, collaborative engineering teams and coordinate technical activities with subcontractors, vendors, and government stakeholders. * Strong engineering judgment and the ability to evaluate design decisions, communicate technical impacts, and identify appropriate system\-level tradeoffs. * Broad understanding of manufacturing processes and the ability to evaluate the advantages, limitations, and applicability of different manufacturing approaches for maritime systems. * Demonstrated experience with 3D CAD modeling, engineering design, and technical drawing generation. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical concepts and engineering recommendations to multidisciplinary stakeholders. * Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in early\-stage development environments, including projects requiring rapid design iterations and size, weight, and power (SWaP)\-constrained redesigns. Preferred Skills and Qualifications * Advanced degree (M.S., M.Eng., or Ph.D.) in Mechanical, Electromechanical, Ocean, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with 10\+ years of relevant professional experience. * Experience designing and developing underwater, maritime, autonomous, or subsea systems. * Experience supporting defense\-related research, development, test, and evaluation (RDT\&E) programs. * Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering teams involving mechanical, electrical, ocean, software, and systems engineers, as well as applied mathematicians. * General familiarity with subsea system components and technologies, including sensors, communications systems, actuators, and propulsion systems. * Proficiency with engineering design and analysis tools, including SolidWorks, Product Data Management (PDM) systems, MATLAB, and/or Python. * Experience performing dimensional and tolerance analyses, including SolidWorks TolAnalyst or comparable tools such as CETOL 6, EZtol, or 3DCS. * Experience with advanced manufacturing processes, including CNC machining, laser welding, and metal additive manufacturing. * Functional understanding of electromagnetic and electromechanical components, including motors, transducers, linear actuators, and related technologies. * Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to develop practical engineering solutions to complex technical challenges. Why is This a Great Opportunity We are seeking an experienced Mechanical, Electromechanical, Ocean, or Advanced Manufacturing Engineer to support the development of advanced subsea research and development (R\&D) systems for DARPA, the Office of Naval Research (ONR), and the broader U.S. Navy.

jobs.title: Senior Database Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Profile** ---------------- Join our team as a Senior Database Engineer and help us modernize the database platforms that power LSEG Analytics! We work with large, complex data environments spanning Oracle, PostgreSQL, Azure, AWS, and on\-premises infrastructure. Together, we support critical production systems while transforming our database estate for the cloud. This is an opportunity to combine deep database expertise with cloud technology, automation, and engineering. You’ll solve challenging technical problems, improve the way we operate, and help us build scalable and resilient platforms for the future! **What You’ll Be Doing** ------------------------ You’ll join a global team working across both day\-to\-day production engineering and strategic modernization projects. We’re moving more of our database estate to the cloud, and you’ll play an important role in helping us make that transition successfully. **You’ll:** ----------- * Build, optimize, and support Oracle and PostgreSQL database platforms. * Modernize databases as we move from on\-premises infrastructure to Azure and cloud environments. * Use Oracle GoldenGate to manage replication and data movement across distributed systems. * Improve database performance, reliability, security, backup, and recovery. * Automate database operations using Python, Bash, or Shell. * Solve complex production and performance issues through hands\-on troubleshooting. * Collaborate with engineering and DevSecOps teams to improve our platforms and ways of working. Along the way, you’ll have opportunities to work with technologies including Oracle Exadata, RAC, ASM, Data Guard, and Oracle Database@Azure. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- We’re looking for someone with deep database engineering experience who enjoys solving problems and adapting as technology evolves. You don’t need to know every technology in our environment from day one. **You’ll bring:** ----------------- * 10\+ years of database engineering, database administration, or enterprise data platform experience. * Strong hands\-on Oracle database engineering experience. * Experience working with PostgreSQL. * Hands\-on experience with Oracle GoldenGate and database replication. * Experience with Oracle technologies such as Exadata, RAC, ASM, or Data Guard. * Experience migrating databases between on\-premises and cloud environments. * Experience working with databases in Microsoft Azure. * Scripting experience using Python, Bash, Shell, or similar technologies. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. We value people who communicate openly, share knowledge, and enjoy working with teams across different technologies and locations. **Nice to Have** ---------------- If you also bring experience with AWS, Datadog, Oracle Enterprise Manager, Azure Fabric, Oracle Database@Azure, financial services, or financial\-data platforms, we’d love to hear about **Career Stage:** Senior Associate **LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.** Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions. Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance. Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy. Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops. Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you. We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. jobs.title: Embedded Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Embedded Systems Engineer, Robotics** **Location:** Gainesville, FL **WHERE SOFTWARE MEETS THE PHYSICAL WORLD** Skin cancer kills 15,000 Americans a year. Not because it cannot be caught early, but because the imaging technology clinicians have access to was not designed to catch it. Lumijes is building the platform that changes that: a system combining robotics, multi\-spectral photonic imaging, and clinical AI to expose what conventional 2D snapshots leave hidden beneath the surface. We are hiring an Embedded Systems Engineer to own the layer where all of it comes together: the boards, firmware, drivers, and real\-time communication that let our robots, sensors, and cameras work as one system. When a new board lands on the bench, you are the one who brings it to life. When something breaks, you are the one who figures out whether it is hardware or software, and then you fix it. **WHAT YOU’LL BUILD:** You will own the foundation the rest of the platform runs on. Your work decides whether the system is fast, deterministic, and safe enough to sit next to a patient. * Board bring\-up and validation: bring up, test, and debug new PCBs, read schematics and layouts, and use lab tools to isolate hardware faults from software faults. * Firmware and drivers: write low\-level firmware for MCUs on bare\-metal or RTOS, and develop device drivers for embedded Linux platforms and SOMs such as NVIDIA Jetson and AMD Kria. * Communication stacks: implement and tune real\-time data protocols across the robot, including CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, I2C, SPI, UART, USB, and Ethernet. * Sensor and actuator integration: connect cameras (GMSL, MIPI CSI\-2\), LiDARs, IMUs, encoders, and motor controllers with synchronized data pipelines and deterministic timing. * Diagnostics and safety: build watchdogs, safe\-stop routines, telemetry logging, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test fixtures, because field reliability is not optional in a clinical device. * Cross\-functional collaboration: work side by side with electrical, mechanical, controls, and robotics software (ROS/ROS 2\) engineers to balance power, thermal, and bandwidth constraints. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR We want engineers who are just as comfortable with a scope probe in hand as they are in a debugger, and who do not wait for someone else to tell them where the problem is. * 5\+ years of professional embedded systems experience, with hardware you have helped bring up and ship, not just support. * Strong C and C\+\+ for firmware and drivers, plus working Python for test automation and scripting. * Microcontrollers and RTOS: ARM Cortex\-M, STM32, ESP32, or similar, using bare\-metal or RTOS environments such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or ThreadX. * Embedded Linux: kernel configuration, device trees, U\-Boot, and board support packages (BSPs). * Lab and debugging tools: hands\-on with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and JTAG/SWD debuggers. * Networking and busses: practical implementation of serial and field busses like CAN, EtherCAT, I2C, and SPI. * B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. **NICE TO HAVE:** * ROS/ROS 2 middleware and robotics data streaming experience (TF, sensor topics). * Familiarity with robot simulation and motion planning tools such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, MoveIt, or cuRobo. * PCB design experience in Altium Designer or KiCad, enough to suggest schematic fixes with confidence. * Knowledge of motor control (PID, encoder feedback) and power electronics. * A background deploying mobile robots, drones, or autonomous systems into unstructured, real\-world environments. **WHO THRIVES HERE:** We move fast by design. We do not speculate; we prototype, test, and learn. There is no approval committee reviewing your technical decisions and no six\-month roadmap insulating you from accountability. You own your boards, your firmware, and your outcomes. The people who love working here are the ones who cannot leave a flaky signal alone until they know exactly why it is happening. They find meaning in work that is genuinely difficult and genuinely consequential, and they get uncomfortable when things slow down for reasons they can control. If that sounds like you, we want to talk. **READY TO SHOW US WHAT YOU CAN D0?** Apply directly through Indeed, or take it a step further and email us at joinus@lumijes.com with examples of your work. Skip the generic application. Tell us about something you have brought to life: a board you brought up, firmware you are proud of, or a stubborn hardware bug you tracked down and how you cracked it. If the work is under NDA, walk us through the problem and your approach. What you can do matters more to us than what your résumé says you might be able to do. **lumijes.com/careers** Application Question(s): * This position is located in Gainesville, FL. Are you living in this area currently or planning to move soon? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Robotics Software Engineer** **Location:** Gainesville, FL · On\-site **Type:** Full\-time **PERFECT IT IN SIMULATION. PROVE IT ON THE ROBOT** Skin cancer kills 15,000 Americans a year. Not because it cannot be caught early, but because the imaging technology clinicians have access to was not designed to catch it. Lumijes is building the platform that changes that: a system combining robotics, multi\-spectral photonic imaging, and clinical AI to expose what conventional 2D snapshots leave hidden beneath the surface. Our cobots work inches away from patients and medical staff, so every motion has to be precise, smooth, and safe. We are hiring a Robotics Software Engineer to join our Simulation and Control software team and build and refine the virtual worlds where that motion is designed and tested: the digital twins, kinematics, and trajectory pipelines that get it right before code ever touches physical hardware. Then you will take those models onto the real cobot, tune its motion operations, and make sure it moves exactly the way the simulation said it would. **WHAT YOU'LL BUILD:** You will sit at the center of our sim\-to\-real loop. Your work speeds up our development cycle and decides how confidently we can put a robot next to a patient. * Digital twins: import and configure 3D CAD models into physics simulators, and define joint limits, link properties, and mass properties. * Virtual sensors: model camera, force/torque, and proximity sensors inside simulated environments. * Kinematics and trajectories: implement and test forward and inverse kinematics (FK/IK) and trajectory generation algorithms. * Workspace analysis: identify singularities, reachability constraints, and joint torque limits, and use simulation to find imaging sensor coverage limits or excess angles during motion. * Collision avoidance: develop and evaluate routines that protect patients and equipment. * Automated testing: run rigorous simulation tests to catch edge\-case bugs, and maintain regression suites for robot motion control software. * Sim\-to\-real transfer: move simulation motion models onto the physical cobot, map its full range of motion, and compare real test bed data against virtual metrics until they match. * Imaging collaboration: work with our imaging software team to improve cobot operation in challenging orientations so the imaging head can support every movement it needs. * Documentation: document simulation tests and code modules to support medical device software compliance standards. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:** We want engineers who trust the math, test everything, and are not satisfied until the real robot matches the simulation. * B.S. or M.S. in Robotics, Mechatronics, Biomedical Engineering (robotics focus), Mechanical Engineering, or Computer Science. * A solid foundation in C\+\+ and/or Python, with clean code practices. * Practical ROS / ROS 2 experience, whether through academic projects, internships, or your own repositories. * Experience authoring custom BehaviorTree.cpp nodes or using the MoveIt Pro Developer Platform. * Hardware abstraction: configuring ros2\_control, writing URDF/XACRO files, and integrating 6\-DOF or 7\-DOF arms such as Universal Robots, Kinova, Franka, Fanuc, or KUKA. * Familiarity with physics simulators like NVIDIA Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, Gazebo, Webots, or MuJoCo. * A strong baseline in linear algebra, rigid\-body dynamics, and robot kinematics (Denavit\-Hartenberg parameters, quaternions). * Rigorous attention to detail, strong documentation habits, and a safety\-first mindset. **NICE TO HAVE:** * Experience or internships with commercial cobot arms such as KUKA LBR Med, Fairino, Rainbow Robotics, Universal Robots, or Franka Emika. * A basic understanding of medical device software life cycle standards such as IEC 62304\. * Experience with Git version control and CI/CD testing pipelines. **WHO THRIVES HERE:** We move fast by design. We do not speculate; we prototype, test, and learn. There is no approval committee reviewing your technical decisions and no six\-month roadmap insulating you from accountability. You own your models, your code, and your outcomes. The people who love working here are the ones who cannot let a trajectory go until it is smooth, safe, and repeatable. They find meaning in work that is genuinely difficult and genuinely consequential, and they get uncomfortable when things slow down for reasons they can control. **READY TO SHOW US WHAT YOU CAN DO?** Apply directly through Indeed, or take it a step further and email us at joinus@lumijes.com with examples of your work. Skip the generic application. Tell us about something you have made move: a simulation you built, a motion planning problem you solved, or a time the real robot did not match the model and how you closed the gap. A link to a repo, project, or demo video is welcome. What you can do matters more to us than what your résumé says you might be able to do. **lumijes.com** Application Question(s): * This position is located in Gainesville, FL. Are you living in this area currently or planning to move soon? * Do you have any experience with Moveit Pro? Work Location: In person
