jobs.title: Faculty - Professor of Mechanical Engineering, Tenure-Track, Open Rank
jobs.description: **About North Park** Founded in 1891, North Park University is a Christian university affiliated with the Evangelical Covenant Church of over 3,200 students from around the country and the world. Located for over 125 years on the land of the Miami and Potawatomi tribes in what is today Chicago’s northside, NPU has recently been designated a Hispanic Serving Institution and is committed to serving diverse populations. Elevating North Park University’s core distinctives of Christian, city\-centered, and intercultural, NPU values diversity among its Faculty and is committed to building a racially and culturally diverse intellectual community, and strongly encourages the nomination and candidacies of persons who are Black, Indigenous, and People of Color regardless of gender. North Park University is located in the Albany Park neighborhood of Chicago, one of the most ethnically diverse zip codes in the United States. It is nine miles from downtown Chicago. The North Park campus has often been referred to as an oasis in the heart of the city – a place where students from urban, rural, and suburban backgrounds alike can call home. And all of this within the major metropolitan backdrop of Chicago: one of the world’s largest and most diversified economies, renowned for its museums and music, and voted best large city in the U.S. for four years in a row by Condé Nast Traveler. **Mission** The mission of North Park University is to prepare students for lives of significance and service through education in the liberal arts, professional studies, and theology. **Vision** Building on our core institutional identity—Christian, city\-centered, intercultural—our vision is to create a university of uncommon character and enduring excellence, where faith, learning, and service meet. **Position Summary** The College of Arts and Sciences at North Park University invites applications for **two open\-rank, full\-time tenure\-track faculty** positions in Mechanical Engineering in the Department of Physics and Engineering, with an **anticipated start date in August 2027\.** Building on the continued growth of the Mechanical Engineering program and its successful ABET accreditation beginning in 2026, the department seeks colleagues who will contribute to the program’s continued development, academic excellence, and long term success. The successful candidates will be committed to excellent undergraduate teaching, student mentoring, program development, and collaborative service. Teaching assignments will reflect each candidate’s qualifications and areas of expertise, with opportunities to contribute broadly to the undergraduate Mechanical Engineering curriculum. **Responsibilities:** Primary Teaching Areas Position 1 – Primary teaching responsibilities will include engineering thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat and mass transfer. Position 2 – Primary teaching responsibilities will span the broader undergraduate mechanical engineering curriculum in solid mechanics. Faculty Responsibilities\- Each successful candidate will teach engineering courses. Additional responsibilities include advising and mentoring undergraduate students, maintaining an appropriate scholarly agenda, contributing to curriculum and program development, and participating in university\-wide service. Rank and salary are commensurate with qualifications and experience. ***Salary Range: $72,000 \- $80,000*** **Requirements** **Required:** * Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field. * Demonstrated commitment to high\-quality undergraduate engineering education and to building productive relationships with industry. * Evidence of professional engineering practice or applied engineering experience. * A clear understanding of and personal commitment to North Park University’s mission of Christian higher education. * Strong attention to detail, with excellent organizational, planning, and communication skills. **Desired:** * Licensure as a Professional Engineer (P.E.). * For Position 1, teaching or professional experience in engineering thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat and mass transfer. For Position 2, demonstrated breadth and flexibility to teach across the general undergraduate mechanical engineering curriculum in solid mechanics. * Experience supervising engineering capstone or senior design projects. * Experience teaching in and supporting an undergraduate Mechanical Engineering curriculum would be an advantage. Active participation in industry organizations and/or professional and scientific communities. * Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively, with a proactive approach to program and departmental needs. Comfort with and effective use of modern instructional, computational, and engineering technologies. * **Benefits** * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Prescription Plan * Flexible Spending Account * Commuter Benefit * Life Insurance * Disability Insurance * Retirement Plan * Tuition Remission * Helwig Recreation Center

jobs.title: AI Claims Engineer
jobs.description: **About notch** Notch builds AI for complex, high\-stakes operations. Our platform helps insurance companies move work across customer conversations, documents, and enterprise systems \- with governance, traceability, and human oversight built in. The AI Workforce takes on repeatable tasks, while the AI Workspace gives professionals a connected place to investigate, prepare, and decide. We began inside insurance operations, so we know that real transformation demands more than a great demo: it has to work against actual business rules, real exceptions, and real\-world pressure. Notch has raised $45 million to date, including a $30 million Series A in 2026\. **About the role** This is a new kind of insurance role: part claims expert, part workflow designer, part product partner, and part trusted customer advisor. You won't spend your day adjusting claims or writing production code. You will work with adjusters, claims leaders, and the Notch team to find the work that slows a claim down, design a better approach, and test whether AI can carry it out safely and reliably. You know why the details matter: a police report can contradict the FNOL, a missing photo can stall a decision, and a seemingly simple claim can become a sensitive exception. Your job is to bring that practical judgment into the way our product is built, deployed, and improved. The goal is not just fewer touches \- it is better information and better decisions, with the adjuster in control. **Compensation:** $125,000\-$175,000 base salary \+ plus equity and benefits. **What you'll do** * **Understand the real workflow \-** Work alongside carriers, TPAs, and claims teams to map the journey from FNOL through triage, investigation, documentation, escalation, and resolution. Spot bottlenecks, manual handoffs, and avoidable rework. * **Turn expertise into working AI \-** Translate claims procedures, authority limits, coverage considerations, service standards, and exception rules into clear workflows for Notch's AI Workspace and AI Workforce. * **Design practical use cases \-** Shape experiences such as voice\-based FNOL, document intake and summarization, claim\-file preparation, missing\-information follow\-up, QA review, and next\-best\-action support. * **Test like a claims professional \-** Create realistic scenarios and evaluate outputs against source documents. Challenge missing facts, ambiguous coverage, conflicting evidence, incorrect escalation, and misleading recommendations before customers rely on them. * **Guide customers from pilot to adoption \-** Join discovery sessions, workshops, demos, pilots, and training. Help claims teams understand when to trust automation, when to review it, and where people must retain authority. * **Be the voice of claims inside Notch \-** Partner with Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to explain the difficult edge cases and translate customer feedback into product improvements. * **Prove and repeat the value \-** Measure improvements in handling time, file completeness, touches per claim, quality, and policyholder experience. Document patterns and playbooks we can reuse across customers. Requirements: **What you'll bring** * You have worked in claims long enough to know what looks straightforward on a process chart and what actually happens on a busy claims desk. You are ready to improve that work, not just do more of it. * Around 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in P\&C claims adjusting, claims operations, claims quality, or a closely related insurance function. * Strong familiarity with claim intake, documentation, triage, coverage review, escalation, communication, and the controls that make a claim defensible. * The judgment to distinguish a useful AI recommendation from an answer that merely sounds convincing. * Genuine curiosity about AI and software. You do not need to be a developer, but you want to learn how systems behave, how to test them, and how to improve them. * Clear communication with both insurance professionals and technical teams. You can explain an operational issue precisely without drowning people in jargon. * Comfort with ambiguity, customer conversations, and hands\-on iteration; a bias for taking ownership and making a workflow better each time. **The extras we love** * Experience with Guidewire, Duck Creek, or other claims management systems; claims transformation or vendor implementation projects. * Exposure to commercial or specialty claims, bodily injury, complex property losses, SIU referrals, CAT operations, or claims QA/audit. * Experience building process maps, test scenarios, SOPs, no\-code workflows, or internal tools. **Why this role matters** Instead of working one claim at a time, you will help shape how thousands of claims are handled. You will make AI useful to the people who carry the responsibility: reducing administrative work, strengthening the record, and giving adjusters more time for the judgment and empathy no system can replace. **Interested?** We would love to hear how you would improve a workflow you know from the inside.

jobs.title: AI Underwriting Engineer
jobs.description: **About Notch** Notch builds AI for complex, high\-stakes operations. Our platform helps insurance companies move work across customer conversations, documents, and enterprise systems \- with governance, traceability, and human oversight built in. The AI Workforce takes on repeatable tasks, while the AI Workspace gives professionals a connected place to investigate, prepare, and decide. We began inside insurance operations, so we know that real transformation demands more than a great demo: it has to work against actual business rules, real exceptions, and real\-world pressure. Notch has raised $45 million to date, including a $30 million Series A in 2026\. **About the role** This is a new kind of insurance role: part underwriting expert, part workflow designer, part product partner, and part trusted customer advisor. You won't be here to quote or bind risks on Notch's behalf, and you don't need to be a software engineer. You'll partner with underwriters, underwriting leaders, brokers, and our teams to rethink how submissions move from first email to decision\-ready file. You know the difference between information being present and information being usable. An ACORD can disagree with a statement of values, loss runs may omit critical context, and a broker follow\-up can delay an otherwise attractive opportunity. You will turn that practical knowledge into workflows that save time, improve the quality of the file, and keep risk selection and pricing judgment with the underwriter. **Compensation:** $125,000\-$175,000 base salary \+ plus equity and benefits. **What you'll do** * **Understand the underwriting desk \-** Work with carriers, MGAs, and brokers to map submission intake, clearance, appetite triage, document review, broker requests, referral, renewal preparation, and the handoffs between teams and systems. * **Turn expertise into working AI \-** Translate underwriting guidelines, risk appetite, submission requirements, authority rules, and escalation points into understandable processes for Notch's AI Workspace and AI Workforce. * **Design practical use cases \-** Shape AI\-assisted ACORD and SOV extraction, loss\-run analysis, missing\-information detection, broker follow\-up, enrichment, submission comparison, renewal preparation, and decision\-ready case summaries. * **Test like an underwriter \-** Build realistic submission scenarios and validate results against evidence. Look for conflicting exposure data, incomplete schedules, unsupported risk conclusions, inaccurate classifications, and missing source references. * **Guide customers from pilot to adoption \-** Lead domain discussions during discovery, demos, pilots, workshops, and training. Help teams adopt AI in ways that fit underwriting controls instead of bypassing them. * **Be the voice of underwriting inside Notch \-** Partner with Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to surface domain\-specific edge cases, prioritize product gaps, and make new capabilities meaningful to end users. * **Prove and repeat the value \-** Track time to a complete submission, underwriter touches, broker response cycles, data quality, and decision readiness. Build playbooks we can apply across lines, carriers, and MGAs. Requirements: **What you'll bring** * You understand underwriting work because you have lived it: the deadlines, the back\-and\-forth, the imperfect data, and the judgment that cannot be reduced to a checklist. You want to improve the system around that judgment. * Around 3\+ years of experience as an underwriter, assistant underwriter, underwriting operations specialist, or in a related carrier, MGA, or brokerage role. * Working knowledge of submissions, ACORD forms, SOVs, loss runs, broker communication, appetite and referral rules, and renewal workflows. * A strong instinct for what makes a file truly decision\-ready, and where a system should stop and ask a human. * Genuine curiosity about AI and software. Coding is not required; comfort learning new tools, testing their outputs, and improving workflows is. * The ability to translate between underwriters, business leaders, and technical teams, with clear and confident written and verbal communication. * An ownership mindset: comfortable tackling ambiguous problems, working with customers, and iterating until the process works in practice. **The extras we love** * Experience in commercial P\&C, specialty or E\&S lines, delegated authority, program business, or complex renewals. * Familiarity with underwriting workbenches, Guidewire, Duck Creek, broker platforms, rating tools, or submission\-management technology. * Experience with workflow design, data validation, no\-code tools, UAT, process improvement, or implementation projects. **Why this role matters** Instead of preparing one submission at a time, you will help build the way underwriting teams operate. Your expertise will make AI more useful, more reliable, and more accountable \- so underwriters have cleaner information, more room for judgment, and better opportunities to write the right business. **Interested?** We would love to hear how you would improve a workflow you know from the inside.

jobs.title: Production Supervisor
jobs.description: **About Oat Foundry** Oat Foundry is an award\-winning agency founded 13 years ago that designs and builds cool analog technology. Our beautiful, nostalgic products, like Split Flap and Picture Flap, and Chroma Flap are shipped and installed all around the world. Our innovative team builds our products in our design and manufacturing facility, all under one roof in Philadelphia. We believe in being dedicated, humble, curious, detail\-oriented, and lighthearted. **About the Opportunity** The Production Supervisor runs Oat Foundry's shop floor. You own manufacturing: every Split Flap, Picture Flap, and Chroma Flap and Add\-on that leaves the building gets built, inspected, packed, and shipped under your watch. You manage the production team, set the pace against the production schedule, and keep materials, inventory, and purchasing flowing so the team never waits on a part. This role works daily with Oat Foundry's President. You execute the production schedule, keep it accurate, and raise the alert early when a date is at risk. The job is equal parts leading people, managing physical stuff, and keeping the systems that track both correct. This is a full time position, based in Philadelphia at Oat Foundry's HQ. **Who Thrives Here** * You lead from the floor. You teach, technicians get better because they work for you, and you jump on the line when it’s necessary. * You like an organized space. If *MRPEasy* says 40 and the shelf says 32, that gap bothers you until it's fixed. * You like making physical things move: parts in, product out, on a schedule you can own. * You sweat the details that protect quality, from incoming inspection to the final check before a crate closes. **RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE:** Production: * Lead and manage the production team, including Senior Production Technicians and Production Technicians with responsibility for output, development, and feedback * Maintain and administer the company's manufacturing resource planning software (*MRPEasy*) to track utilization metrics, inventory metrics, forecast metrics, among others * Own manufacturing of all Oat Foundry products and add\-ons, including module and cabinet assembly with basic hand tools up to and including CNC routing and welding of components * Execute the production schedule set with Oat Foundry’s Project Engineer and keep the forecasting inputs current * Train the team on provided work instructions and keep that training up to date. * Keep production areas organized, clean, and safe, and own the storage and flow of materials through the shop physically and digitally * Support New Product Development prototype builds * Contribute to department budgeting and forecasting, and ensure production bills and POs are reconciled and paid on time * Report production status at the weekly Operations L10 and keep the department’s scorecard numbers current Materials, Procurement \& Inventory: * Own procurement of off\-the\-shelf components * Set up and perform incoming inspection of procured parts, particularly custom components * Manage inventory physically and digitally via MRP: accurate counts, physical segregation of quarantined parts, and captured write\-offs. Maintenance of BOMs to reflect accurate counts of consumption Quality \& Compliance: * Ensure training and performance of direct reports complies with work instructions and intended quality checks to meet standards conveyed by Support \& Quality Technician * Train technicians on operations that are within compliance to certifications and standards such as UL48 and ISO Shipping, Installation \& Support: * Complete contracted installation and commissioning work * Support rental fulfillment and training * Procure and convey requirements for product crating solutions **You will need:** * A track record of delivering projects with physical deliverables (manufacturing, fabrication, or similar) * 3\+ years of production management experience * Experience leading technicians or skilled trades in a manufacturing or fabrication environment * A bachelor's degree in any field, or equivalent experience * Experience running an MRP, ERP, or inventory management system, and comfort holding a team accountable to the numbers in it. A hands\-on skills assessment is part of our interview process * Enough technical fluency and curiosity to follow an engineering conversation and ask good questions * Exceptional organization and time management * Excellent verbal and written communication * A positive attitude, energy, and enthusiasm **Key Performance Indicators:** * On\-time delivery: production schedule adherence, with ship and install dates hit as committed * Quality: QA pass rates and rework trending down, no escaped defects reaching customers * Inventory accuracy: MRP counts match physical counts, write\-offs captured, quarantine discipline maintained, production technician utilization as expected * Team output and safety: production quotas hit, shop clean and safe, training to work instructions current **Bonus Points For:** * Hands\-on fabrication skills: handtools, CNC, laser etching/cutting, or similar * Experience with UL, ISO, or similar compliance standards * ClickUp or similar project management platform fluency * Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel fluency * Lean manufacturing or 5S experience **COMPENSATION \& EMPLOYMENT STATUS** This position is full time, at\-will and comes with a base salary with variable compensation, and benefits including Unlimited PTO, Subsidized Health Insurance, 401(k), Parental Leave, Kitchen Snacks and Groceries, Profit Sharing when available, and more **ESTIMATED COMPENSATION INFORMATION (YEARLY):** $55,000 \- $65,000 Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Which MRP, ERP, or inventory system have you run, and what were you personally responsible for keeping accurate in it? jobs.description: ### **Build the Path Forward** At Path Robotics, we're building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI\-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world, closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field\-ready AI that is risk\-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real\-world use. Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together. We're seeking Robotics Software Engineers who thrive on making big, complex systems work together in the real world. We currently have **experienced and senior** openings on the team. Our robots combine industrial hardware, real\-time C\+\+ control, ROS, cloud services, and the latest machine learning research. This team ties all of it into one reliable product and scales it from a few cells to dozens of systems running in production on customer factory floors. You'll write the drivers, ROS nodes, deployment tooling, and telemetry that make that possible. You'll be hands\-on with the robots, bringing systems up, debugging them, and working with factory technicians to keep them running. ### **What You'll Do** **Experienced:** * **Write drivers for robotic and industrial hardware.** Build and maintain the drivers that connect our software to robot controllers, sensors, cameras, PLCs, and other industrial equipment, behind clean, reliable interfaces. * **Ship software to the fleet.** Package software in Docker, and build and improve the deployment, configuration, and update tooling that gets it onto dozens of robots reliably. * **Get research onto the robot.** Help integrate and deploy new machine learning models and features from our research teams onto real robotic hardware. * **Bring up and support systems on the factory floor.** Install, test, and troubleshoot systems with factory technicians, including networking and connectivity issues, and turn what you learn into fixes in the code. * **Write solid, tested code.** Contribute unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and help keep CI/CD healthy. **Senior:** * **Connect the full stack.** Own the integration layer across modern C\+\+, Python, ROS 1/2, Docker, AWS, web services, and industrial robot controllers, so that new capabilities reach the robot cleanly and reliably. * **Get research into production.** Partner with our machine learning and research teams to package, deploy, and run new learning\-based models on real robotic hardware. * **Scale from a handful of cells to a fleet.** Build the deployment, configuration, and update infrastructure that takes development and demonstration systems to dozens of robots in production. * **Architect large systems.** Organize and design how large numbers of robotic hardware and software components fit together: interfaces, ownership boundaries, versioning, and deployment. * **Build consensus across teams.** Work with hardware, controls, perception, ML, cloud, and field operations teams to understand their needs, propose integration solutions, and bring stakeholders to agreement. * **Mentor engineers.** Provide technical leadership and help experienced engineers grow their system design skills. ### **Who You Are** * A Bachelor's in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 3\+ years (Experienced) / 6\+ years (Senior) building software in modern C\+\+ (Python a strong plus), with hands\-on work on robots or other physical hardware. * Experience with ROS 2\. * Familiarity with ROS, DDS, gRPC, and other communications middleware. * Comfortable with multithreading, concurrency, and debugging systems\-level behavior on real hardware. * Fluent developing and operating software on Linux, with Git. * You enjoy hands\-on work and are willing to spend time on the factory floor with the robots. * **Senior:** A track record of shipping and supporting industrial robotic systems in production. Experience writing drivers or hardware interfaces, deploying containerized software with Docker on AWS or similar platforms, and handling telemetry, remote management, networking, and security for deployed systems. Experience designing large systems of robotics hardware and software, and comfort leading cross\-team technical discussions to a decision. ### **Why You'll Love Working Here** * Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team * Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total) * 401(k) retirement plan through Empower * Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team! ### **Who We Are** At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process or any part of the hiring process, please contact HR@path\-robotics.com. We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.

jobs.title: GIS Analyst 2
jobs.description: **Position Title:** GIS Analyst 2 **Duration:** 6\+ Months **Location:** Mechanicsville, VA · Seeking a detail\-oriented professional to locate, verify, and document transportation structures while supporting the development and maintenance of geospatial data and tools to ensure accurate, accessible information for planning and asset management. · The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately locating, verifying, and documenting bridges, culverts, and other transportation structures to support precise mapping and reliable statewide infrastructure data. This position plays a key role in developing, maintaining, and enhancing geospatial datasets and mapping products, with a focus on linear referencing systems (LRS), ArcGIS Online solutions, and enterprise data integration. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to ensure transportation\-related spatial data is accurate, accessible, and compliant with organizational standards. This role is essential to supporting data\-driven planning, operations, and asset management across the agency. **Key Responsibilities** · Geospatial Data Management and Quality Assurance · Identify and locate structures within RNS using GIS tools, roadway datasets, and structure inventory records. · Verify structure attributes such as route, milepoint, feature crossed, and structure number against official documentation. · Update and maintain structure location data in alignment with VDOT standards and revision protocols. · Investigate and resolve discrepancies between field data and system records. · Perform QA/QC on spatial datasets and participate in audits and quality assurance reviews of RNS structure data. · Maintain documentation for datasets, workflows, and data maintenance procedures. **Spatial Analysis and Technical GIS Operations** · Develop, maintain, and analyze datasets using linear referencing systems for transportation networks. · Execute enterprise GIS workflows, including geoprocessing, spatial analysis, data modeling, and automation. · Troubleshoot spatial data issues and ensure data quality, consistency, and metadata compliance. · Integrate spatial and non\-spatial datasets from multiple sources. **GIS Application Development and Platform Management** · Create and manage feature services, web maps, dashboards, and applications within ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise. · Support the development and enhancement of GIS tools, automated processes, and geospatial applications. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Support** · Collaborate with Systems \& Data Management teams to ensure consistency and accuracy across RNS and related databases. · Support engineers and maintenance teams by providing accurate structure location data for inspections, planning, and operations. · Work with internal stakeholders to gather requirements, design GIS solutions, and deliver geospatial products. **Reporting, Communication, and Training** · Prepare reports and documentation for newly located, updated, or modified structures. · Provide technical support, training, and guidance on geospatial tools, best practices, and data standards. Pay: $50\.00 \- $55\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ QISG leverages Quanta’s comprehensive resources to deliver collaborative solutions for our partners' energy infrastructure needs. We use in\-house talent, expertise and resources to plan, design, engineer, manage, conduct maintenance on and construct projects. Our turnkey service capabilities provide our customers with efficiency, consistency, attention to detail and safe execution. The QISG team brings together Engineering, Safety, Quality, Material Procurement, QA/QC, Right\-of\-Way Acquisition, Scheduling, Environmental Planning, Permitting, Title and Land Management expertise that ensure outstanding results for our clients. **About this Role** ------------------- QISG leverages Quanta’s comprehensive resources to deliver collaborative solutions for our partners' energy infrastructure needs. We use in\-house talent, expertise and resources to plan, design, engineer, manage, conduct maintenance on and construct projects. Our turnkey service capabilities provide our customers with efficiency, consistency, attention to detail and safe execution. The QISG team brings together Engineering, Safety, Quality, Material Procurement, QA/QC, Right\-of\-Way Acquisition, Scheduling, Environmental Planning, Permitting, Title and Land Management expertise that ensure outstanding results for our clients. The Business Analyst is a hybrid analytics and GIS role that sits in the Environmental/Land PMO (EnvPM) and gives dedicated support to Business Development under the Sr. Director of BD. The analyst owns spatial data management in Transect, turning route, site and constraint data into the scope, risk and schedule inputs that EnvPM and BD need to win and baseline pursuits. The role exists because EnvPM is most heavily involved during pursuit, where it defines scope, builds the Division of Responsibility (DOR) and draft Permit Matrix, and prices risk before Gate 1\. Getting spatial data right at that stage lets the team qualify routes and sites faster, answer clients with confidence, and hand construction teams a clean geospatial record. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **GIS and spatial data management (Transect)** * Administer QISG’s Transect workspace: user access, project folders, layer libraries, naming conventions and data standards. * Load, validate and maintain client\-provided and internal spatial data (KML/KMZ, shapefiles, geodatabases, CAD\-derived files) for each pursuit, with version control and metadata. * Run site and route screening in Transect, and supplement it with public and proprietary layers on wetlands, species, cultural resources, land use, jurisdictions, parcels and community sentiment. * Produce maps, constraint summaries and acreage/mileage quantities that support routing and siting alternatives, limits of disturbance, access and constructability discussions. * Quality\-check OpU and teaming\-partner spatial deliverables; maintain the geospatial archive, including as\-builts and closeout data delivery. * Define and document GIS SOPs and templates with the EnvPM Director so spatial data is handled the same way on every pursuit and project. **Pursuit support (EnvPM)** * Provide spatial inputs for the Division of Responsibility, draft Permit Matrix, Shadow Estimate, risk register and RFQ packages, including permit counts, agency jurisdictions and land\-rights parcel quantities. * Prepare map exhibits, assumptions and clarifications for proposals, and support rapid\-response submittals. * Track change from proposal submittal (Gate 1\) to NTP/LNTP by keeping the spatial baseline current as routes, scope or limits shift. * Support bid leveling and OpU/partner selection with consistent, comparable quantities. **Business development analytics (Sr. Director, BD)** * Maintain pursuit pipeline data in the CRM alongside spatial attributes (location, sector, mileage/acreage, client, stage), and build map\-based pipeline views. * Screen incoming leads for environmental and land feasibility so BD can prioritize pursuit effort across OpUs. * Analyze market, competitor and win/loss data; report pipeline, win\-rate and activity metrics to senior leadership. * Contribute to the proposal content library with standard map graphics and GIS capability descriptions. * Support teaming partner management under BD: maintain the partner roster, teaming agreements, capabilities, past performance and availability, and track each partner’s participation across pursuits. * Assist with RFQ distribution, partner bid leveling and rate card reviews and increases, keeping rate data current and comparable across partners. * Maintain a teaming partner scorecard (responsiveness, pricing competitiveness, win contribution, delivery performance, spatial data quality) to guide partner selection. **Reporting, process and technology** * Build and maintain EnvPM dashboards for leading indicators such as permit cycle times, land rights acquisition rates, inspection findings and variance trends, drawing on spatial and project data. * Build BD reporting dashboards covering pipeline value, forecast, win rate, pursuit activity by sector and OpU, and map\-based views of pursuits and projects. * Publish dashboards on a set cadence (weekly EnvPM, monthly BD leadership) in Power BI or an equivalent tool, with documented definitions and data sources. * Automate routine reporting and data flows between Transect, the CRM, Power BI/Excel and project systems. * Capture lessons learned and recommend improvements to the QISG project lifecycle, templates and tools. * Perform other duties as required. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in GIS, geography, environmental science, engineering, business or a related field, or equivalent experience * 0\-5 years as a business, data or GIS analyst, ideally supporting environmental, permitting, land/right\-of\-way, utility, energy or infrastructure work. * Hands\-on GIS data management: file formats, coordinate systems, data QA, metadata and geodatabase or cloud\-platform administration. * Experience with Transect or a comparable site\-assessment or route/siting platform is a strong asset. Exposure to pursuit, proposal or pipeline reporting is an asset. * Proficient in ArcGIS Pro or QGIS and in KML/KMZ, shapefile and geodatabase workflows. * Working knowledge of permitting, environmental constraints and land\-rights concepts for linear and site\-based projects. * Advanced Excel; Power BI or similar dashboards; Salesforce or another CRM; Python or SQL is an asset. Clear written and visual communication; able to explain spatial findings to non\-GIS audiences. * Organized, detail\-oriented and able to prioritize competing requests from EnvPM and BD under urgent deadlines. * Collaborative; works well with OpUs, teaming partners and engineering without direct authority. **What You'll Get** ------------------- **QISG Benefits Highlights** * Competitive Compensation * Comprehensive Health Coverage \- Multiple Medical, dental \& vision plans with 100% preventive care * 24/7 telehealth (Teladoc) * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Company\-funded HSA and pre\-tax savings options * 401(k) Retirement Plan * No\-cost Short\- and Long\-term Disability * Employer\-paid basic Life \& AD\&D Insurance * Paid Time off (PTO) and 10 Paid Holidays * Paid Parental leave * Education Reimbursement and Professional Development * Employee discount program and optional insurance offerings: * Identity Theft Protection * Accident Insurance * Voluntary Life (spouse and child) * Critical Illness * Hospital Indemnity * Pet Insurance **Compensation Range** ---------------------- The anticipated compensation for this position is USD $60,000\.00/Yr. \- USD $80,000\.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. We prohibit all types of discrimination and are committed to providing access and equal opportunity for individuals with disabilities. For additional information or if reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application, interview, or hiring processes or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact us the Company’s Human Resources department.

jobs.title: CRM Technical Administrator
jobs.description: **About RS Group** RS is a high\-service global product and service solutions provider for industrial customers, enabling them to operate efficiently and sustainably. We operate in 33 markets, stock over 875,000 industrial and specialist products and list an additional five million relevant for our industrial customers, sourced from over 2,500 suppliers. This extensive range supports our customers across the industrial lifecycle of designing, building and maintaining equipment and operations. We enhance their experience through a tailored service model, leveraging our efficient physical, digital and process infrastructure sustainably. We combine a technically led and digitally enabled approach with an exceptional team of experts; ultimately, it’s our people that make the difference. Our purpose, making amazing happen for a better world, reflects our focus on delivering results for people, planet and profit. This role sits at the center of a strategic transformation to modernize sales quoting, pricing, and revenue processes through the implementation of Salesforce Revenue Cloud and related platforms. **About the Role** **Role Purpose** This role sits within the Customer Management Platforms team, which is accountable for the technical ownership, health, architecture, governance, and technical roadmap of RS Group's customer technology platforms, including Customer Data Management (CDM), Customer Data Platform (CDP), and Customer Relationship Management (CRM). Working in partnership with Product Managers, who own the functional product roadmap, and business stakeholders, the team delivers prioritised business and technical outcomes through dedicated Salesforce delivery squads. While this role is primarily focused on Salesforce CPQ and the transformation towards Salesforce Revenue Cloud, it operates within the wider Salesforce ecosystem and may provide expertise, support, and capacity across other Salesforce clouds and customer management platforms as business priorities require. This role is responsible for the configuration, administration, and continuous improvement of CRM platforms, with a particular focus on Salesforce CPQ and the transition to Salesforce Revenue Cloud, supporting sales execution, pricing, contract workflows and commercial growth. Provides technical expertise and platform administration for Salesforce CRM, supporting delivery of business requirements through configuration, workflow automation, platform governance and operational support. **Responsibilities** * Work closely with the initial project team to implement Salesforce Revenue Cloud and CPQ capabilities, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and security. * Collaborate with Sales, Pricing, Product, SAP, Legacy Systems, and GSBS teams to align Salesforce CRM processes with business goals and configure Salesforce.com accordingly. * Responsible for process design around Salesforce integrations with SAP, pricing tools, and other commercial systems. * Build and maintain custom logic (flows, integrations, and configurations) to support ongoing and evolving complex pricing, quoting, and ordering scenarios. * Ensure data integrity across product, pricing, and customer data models. * Coordinate work with Project Managers, Solution Architects, Principal Developers and other Administrators globally for new releases and features, etc. * Collaborate closely with Principal Software Engineers, Solution Architects, Product Owners and business SMEs, to make key design decisions and ensure solutions are scalable, resilient and globally consistent. * Provide ongoing support and advanced troubleshooting to users, addressing complex CRM, pricing, and quoting\-related inquiries and challenges. * Create technical documentation and support release activities. * Work hand\-in\-hand with the Programme team, Revenue Operations team and sales leadership to drive and devleop processes, standards, trainings, and reinforcement. * Create and maintain operational dashboards and platform monitoring capabilities to support platform health, adoption, supportability and technical governance, and provide data\-driven recommendations for continuous improvement. * Identify opportunities to enhance sales productivity and efficiency through technology solutions and continually seek ways to further increase adoption and enhance the end\-user experience. **How I make a difference in this role** This role enables scalable, reliable, and efficient sales and commercial processes through the delivery and continuous improvement of Salesforce capabilities. Whilst primarily focused on Salesforce CPQ and the transition to Salesforce Revenue Cloud, the role also contributes to the wider Salesforce platform ecosystem, improving automation, data quality, user adoption and operational efficiency. **Candidate Requirements** **Essential Skills \& Experience** * Minimum of 7 years of hands\-on experience with Salesforce platform including relevant experience CPQ / Revenue Cloud in a global environment with a sales\-focused background. * Direct experience with new Salesforce CRM implementations, including data and system integrations (SAP, Adobe, etc.). * Experience implementing changes in Salesforce and supporting complex pricing, quoting, and approval workflows. * Experience with integrating multiple technologies with Salesforce.com to ensure an efficient tech stack. * Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. **Desirable Skills \& Experience** * Experience with pricing tools. * Background in B2B sales or distribution environment. * Adobe Commerce experience a plus. * Essential Qualifications (Must be evidenced at offer stage) * Bachelor’s degree in a technical or related field or equivalent experience. * Salesforce certifications (Administrator or CPQ Specialist). **Equal Employment Opportunity** RS Americas is an equal opportunity employer and maintains policies and practices that are designed to prevent and prohibit unlawful discrimination against any qualified employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, ancestry, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, military/veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other unlawful classification to the extent protected by law. This policy of non\-discrimination applies to all employment practices, including hiring, compensation, benefits, promotion, training and termination. Employees who engage in unlawful discrimination will be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination. \#LI\-CC1 \#LI\-HYBRID

jobs.title: Data Center Engineers
jobs.description: **Data Center Engineers (Design \& Infrastructure \- Multi\-Discipline)** **Multiple Locations:** Houston, TX, Washington, DC **Company:** Fortune 500 Energy Company **Role Overview** We are looking for Data Center Engineers to play a critical role in the conceptualization, design oversight, and optimization of critical infrastructure systems that keep our data centers running reliably, efficiently, and sustainably. These roles bridge the gap between high\-level building architecture and the complex mechanical, cooling, and piping networks required to support next\-generation compute loads. You will collaborate with cross\-functional design, construction, and operations teams to review schematics, enforce engineering standards, and drive innovation in thermal management and infrastructure resilience. **Responsibilities** **Building Design \& Spatial Planning** * **Architectural \& Structural Collaboration:** Partner with structural engineers and architects to define spatial requirements, floor loading capacities, and structural zoning for heavy mechanical equipment (e.g., chillers, cooling towers, pumps). * **Egress \& Safety Design:** Ensure data hall and mechanical gallery layouts comply with local building codes, life safety requirements, NFPA standards, and physical security boundaries. * **Scalability Planning:** Design modular, scalable infrastructure frameworks that allow for seamless concurrent maintainability and future capacity expansions without disrupting live environments. **Cooling \& HVAC Systems** * **Thermal Management Design:** Develop and evaluate cooling topologies appropriate for varying high\-density environments, including CRAH/CRAC units, Hot/Cold Aisle Containment, Chilled Water Loops, Evaporative Cooling, and Direct\-to\-Chip Liquid Cooling. * **Psychrometric \& Airflow Optimization:** Utilize Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) analysis to evaluate data hall airflow patterns, eliminate hot spots, and maximize economizer hours. * **Environmental Control:** Design and monitor precise HVAC control strategies for humidity, filtration, and pressurization within the white space and support galleries. **Hydronic \& Piping Schematics** * **Schematic Development:** Author, review, and approve critical mechanical diagrams, including Process \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs), piping schematics, and flow diagrams for condenser and chilled water systems. * **Hydronic Calculation:** Perform or validate hydraulic calculations for pump sizing, pipe friction losses, thermal expansion, water hammer mitigation, and system volume requirements. * **Redundancy \& Topology Verification:** Ensure piping architecture meets strict uptime standards (e.g., Tier III/IV or N\+1/2N topologies) with proper isolation valve placement for concurrent maintenance. **Requirements \& Qualifications** **Education \& Experience** * **Bachelor’s Degree** in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a closely related technical field. * **Minimum of 4–6\+ years** of direct experience in the design, engineering, or operation of mission\-critical facilities (Data Centers, Cleanrooms, or High\-Tech Manufacturing). **Technical Skills** * **Software Proficiency:** Advanced capability with AutoCAD, Revit (BIM), and CFD modeling tools (e.g., 6SigmaRoom, Future Facilities). * **Standards \& Codes:** Deep working knowledge of ASHRAE TC 9\.9 (Thermal Guidelines for Data Processing Environments), ASME piping codes, NFPA standards, and local building/mechanical codes. * **Systems Expertise:** Comprehensive understanding of central plant designs, variable speed pumping, water treatment regimes, and Building Management Systems (BMS/EPMS) sequences of operation. Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $175,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Engineering Technician
jobs.description: A career at Resilience is more than just a job – it’s an opportunity to change the future. Resilience is a technology\-focused biomanufacturing company that’s changing the way medicine is made. We’re building a sustainable network of high\-tech, end\-to\-end manufacturing solutions to better withstand disruptive events, serve scientific discovery, and reach those in need. For more information, please visit www.resilience.com **Brief Job Description** The Engineering Technician supports the Process Execution Team (PET) to deliver manufacturing performance in line with the manufacturing plan. This role leads technical troubleshooting for equipment used within the PET. As a skilled specialist working with limited supervision, individuals in this position self\-generate and implement process improvement projects that support both short\- and long\-term area goals. This role interacts with Operators, PET Engineers, Area Leaders, Validation, PMO, and Quality while serving as the bridge between Manufacturing, Maintenance and PET Engineering. **Job Responsibilities** **Technical troubleshooting and equipment performance** * Serve as the escalation point for complex, intermittent, and cross\-system faults that are not resolved by standard maintenance procedures, applying structured problem solving and troubleshooting techniques to complete repairs and prevent recurrence. * Use a variety of tools, testing and measuring equipment to complete emergency, corrective, and preventative maintenance on equipment and systems used within the PET. * Monitor equipment and systems for performance and problem indicators, and act on early signs of degradation before they cause downtime. **Automation, controls, and data systems** * Work across the area’s automation and data systems, including PLCs, SCADAs, HMIs, servers, databases, data historian, and visualization platforms. * Troubleshoot PLC, I/O, and vision programs. * Implement new PLC/HMI code and modify existing code under approved change control. * Own the control system version control, backup, and restoration program for the area, and the associated data integrity and compliance requirements. * Diagnose and resolve network issues affecting production equipment, including VLAN, subnet, and IP protocol faults. * Analyze trends in equipment and process data to identify root causes, solutions, and improvements. **Process improvement** * Identify and implement continuous improvement projects in changeover reduction, yield improvement, OEE improvement, maintenance reliability, and waste reduction. * Develop project justification and engineering proposals, providing input for the capital planning process. * Participate in new equipment design, providing input for the development of User Requirements, Specifications, and documentation required to qualify new equipment and processes. * Serve as a project resource for new equipment installations, retrofits, and upgrades, and assist with executing validation protocols for equipment and processes. **Quality, compliance, and documentation** * Lead and coordinate technical investigations and studies, and support deviation investigations with technical assessment of equipment and system contribution. * Execute all maintenance and technical work in accordance with SOPs, cGMPs, and OSHA safety requirements, and document it to cGMP standards. * Complete documentation and required functions within the work order system, and maintain compliance with established MRO procedures for inventory control. **Knowledge transfer** * Train Operators and Maintenance Technicians on systems, software, equipment, machines, procedures, and processes. * Provide technical guidance to Operators and Technicians on shift when equipment or system issues arise. **Experience \& Education** **Minimum Qualifications** * Demonstrated experience maintaining and improving automated production equipment in a regulated (cGMP or comparable) manufacturing environment. * Experience and knowledge of ladder logic, with the ability to navigate PLC programs to isolate faults. * Demonstrated ability to lead troubleshooting on automated production equipment and drive an issue to root cause. * Training in mechanics, hydraulics, pneumatics, electronics, and the use of testing equipment for electrical and mechanical troubleshooting. * Experience with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems such as SAP, including work order documentation and established MRO procedures for inventory control. * Ability to read and interpret diagrams, drawings, P\&IDs, electrical schematics, and other technical documentation. * Ability to self\-direct daily work based on an understanding of area business need, and to make independent decisions within the scope of the role, escalating novel or cross\-functional issues to the Area Leader or PET Engineer. * Must have the ability to effectively understand, read, write, communicate, and follow instructions in the English language. **Preferred Qualifications** * Associate degree in engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent mechanical trade school graduate. * 3\+ or more years of experience with automated production equipment. * Experience with OEE, TPM, LEAN, or other continuous improvement systems. * Experience in biologics or sterile drug product manufacturing. * Experience with data historian, SCADA, or visualization platform configuration. **Physical \& Work Environment** * Ability to lift and handle equipment change parts, tooling, and materials associated with equipment maintenance and repair. * Ability to You'll work from the details, not from a PRD. **Why this role matters** **Real\-world impact at scale** * Engineers on every team take turns on\-call, which costs roughly 10 to 15 percent of headcount. The goal is an agent that is first responder to every page, so people are only woken up when a human is needed, and arrive with the root cause in hand. * Make SRE AI first responder for five teams, and the default for every team by the end of 2027\. * Within 12 months, the median developer ships as fast as today's 90th percentile. **Unique technical challenges** * Choose which experiments to run agent factories: Within three months, stand up an end\-to\-end system for campaign\-style work: backfilling tests, fixing recurring logging problems, and drive changes, etc. **You should apply if:** * engineers by earning their trust.** Principal and staff engineers follow you because you're in the details with them. * **You care what things cost.** Tokens and infrastructure are part of the design, MCPs, skills and cloud runners. * Make build, integrate and buy calls across vendors such as Claude and Codex as models change. * Drive cost per pull request down while output goes up. * Take SRE AI from two teams to every team, and build the trust that lets it take more automated actions. * Work directly with every R\&D leader and with the developers who use what you build, without a product manager. * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the L , scientists and operators. jobs.title: Founding backend engineer, data platform and fleet infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Sentis** Sentis is capturing the most accurate state of the human body. We bring all the data a hospital has on a patient into one place. Health AI is only as good as the data it learns from, and most of that data is never captured today. We build at the intersection of physical AI and healthcare. We’re live in US ICUs and scaling from single units to full hospitals. **The role** You own the backend: the platform that takes in data from every node, stores it and makes it usable for training, and the infrastructure that keeps a fleet of devices inside hospitals updated and under control. The tech exists and runs today, so you don’t start from zero. Your job is to challenge all of it with the team and make it as smart and as scalable as it can be, from first principles. We have no ego about what’s there. If you want to change something, change it. It’s yours. **What you’ll do** * Build and run backend services in Go on Postgres, from architecture to on\-call. * Own our AWS infrastructure in Terraform, serverless where it fits. * Build ingestion for per\-second clinical data from every node, with no loss when a hospital network drops. * Store terabytes of time\-series data cheaply and make it easy to export for model training. * Run the fleet: provisioning, device identity, staged OTA updates with automatic rollback, and remote access. * Build logging, tracing and alerting across cloud and devices. * Build in the controls for HIPAA and SOC 2: encryption, audit trails, access control, and deletion per hospital and patient stay. **How we build** Agentic development is a requirement for this role. It only works if you understand backend and infrastructure principles very deeply, and can read, write and judge code yourself. * You write the specs, repo instructions and tests that let agents ship good code. * You run several agents in parallel and review what they produce. * You read every line that touches patient data or device updates yourself. * You decide the architecture. The agents don’t. **You might be a fit if** * You’ve built something hard and can show it: a product from nothing, a system others said couldn’t ship on that timeline, or open\-source work. * You work like a founder. You’ve been a technical founder or first engineer, or you’ve owned a system the same way. * You have 3\+ years shipping production backend software, with on\-call for your own system. * You write production Go, or Rust, Java or Kotlin and you’ll switch fast. * You understand distributed systems deeply and have run them under real load. * You know AWS and Terraform in depth, including serverless infrastructure. * You’ve built data pipelines where losing or duplicating data wasn’t an option. * You’ve worked with IoT or connected devices before. * Agentic development is how you work every day. * Bonus: you’ve run a device fleet in production, with OTA updates and remote management. * Bonus: clinical data, HIPAA or SOC 2\. * You’re based in the US and can work here without visa sponsorship. * You'reopen to traveling with us to clients in the US and if needed, globally **How we work** This role is in person in San Francisco. We’re high pace, high agency and low ego. We hire very good people and then get out of their way. You work freely, you make your own calls, and you get whatever tools you need to do your best work. **Next steps** An intro call, a technical deep dive on a real Sentis problem, and a conversation with both founders. Send us the hardest thing you’ve built and what made it hard. A link or five sentences is enough.

jobs.title: US - Analytics Engineer

standards, lineage, and DQA processes. * Automate and orchestrate data refresh processes for analytics environments. * Build efficient and reusable data models to support Power BI and AI/ML use cases. and business logic that populates them. * Work with FHIR, HL7, and other healthcare data standards to harmonize and integrate data across systems. * Implement best practices for HIPAA compliance, privacy, and secure data handling within all analytics workflows. * Contribute to the modernization of analytics infrastructure, enabling AI and predictive analytics readiness. * Explore and prototype new tools or frameworks to improve efficiency, reliability, or insight delivery. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Healthcare Informatics * 3\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics development, or BI engineering (healthcare experience preferred). * Proficiency in PySpark, SQL, and DAX for data preparation and transformation. * Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools for semantic modeling and visualization. * Understanding of healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7, OMOP) and compliance frameworks (HIPAA). * Experience working in Agile or DevOps environments. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Azure Synapse. * Experience integrating analytics workflows with AI/ML solutions. * Knowledge of version control, CI/CD, and environment\-based deployment practices. * Advanced degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Healthcare Informatics, or related field Compensation is determined based on years of relevant experience and departmental equity.

jobs.title: Cloud Solutions Architect
jobs.description: Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? ***Transform the everyday with us!*** **We are seeking a****Cloud Solutions Architect****based in Wendell, NC., with Remote opportunities.** The Cloud Solutions Architect will shape the solution architecture that enables Business Excellence (BE) and Innovation \& Development (I\&D) teams to build, modernize, integrate, and scale digital products. The role focuses on turning product strategy and engineering needs into secure, reusable, and supportable Microsoft Azure solution patterns. Embedded within Innovation \& Development, this role connects product teams with enterprise technology and cybersecurity partners. It guides cloud adoption, removes technical barriers, and creates shared capabilities that improve delivery speed, reliability, and reuse across the portfolio. This is a product and solution architecture role, not an enterprise infrastructure operations or service\-desk role. #### **You’ll make an impact by:** #### **Digital Product \& Cloud Solution Architecture** * Partner with product owners, software architects, developers, data teams, and business stakeholders to translate product roadmaps into practical cloud architectures. * Assess existing Windows, SQL Server, application, network, storage, identity, and file\-service dependencies; define modernization, migration, cutover, recovery, and retirement plans. * Work closely with Enterprise IT to improve infrastructure engineering and operations, and pave the road for migration from on\-premises to the cloud by modernizing Windows Server, identity, DNS, Group Policy, SQL Server, Azure Virtual Desktop, and application connectivity across hybrid environments. * Design end\-to\-end patterns for digital applications, APIs, integrations, data services, automation, and emerging AI capabilities using Microsoft Azure. * Define clear architecture decisions, interfaces, quality attributes, and implementation guardrails that enable teams to move quickly without creating one\-off solutions. * Evaluate cloud\-native, platform\-based, software\-as\-a\-service, and hybrid options based on business value, user experience, scalability, security, supportability, and lifecycle cost. * Clearly define roles between Enterprise IT and the Cloud Solutions Architect: Enterprise IT owns core infrastructure services, monitoring, and incident escalation, while the architect owns cloud design, migration and cutover plans, dependency maps, and recovery documentation. #### **Product Modernization \& Portfolio Evolution** * Create modernization strategies for existing BE and I\&D products, moving from legacy hosting and tightly coupled dependencies toward modular, cloud\-enabled solutions. * Develop transition roadmaps that align migration sequencing with product priorities, release plans, business continuity, and measurable value. * Identify opportunities to consolidate common capabilities into shared platforms such as Olympus rather than expanding stand\-alone tools or duplicated services. * Guide product teams through architecture validation, technical discovery, proof of concept, production readiness, and post\-release improvement. #### **Reusable Platforms \& Engineering Enablement** * Create reusable blueprints for application hosting, integration, data, identity, observability, and environment management that can be adopted across multiple products. * Enable consistent development, test, quality, and production practices in partnership with software engineering and DevSecOps teams. * Advance automation and infrastructure as code using Azure DevOps, Git, Bicep, Terraform, or PowerShell to improve consistency, traceability, and recovery. * Reduce delivery friction by simplifying how teams access approved cloud capabilities and by resolving cross\-team technical dependencies. #### **Architecture Assurance, Resilience \& Risk** * Embed security, privacy, availability, performance, monitoring, recovery, and cost considerations into product architecture from the beginning. * Partner with cybersecurity and enterprise technology teams to apply approved standards while preserving product\-team speed and accountability. * Assess solution risks, technical debt, single points of failure, vendor dependencies, and support gaps; define pragmatic improvement plans with product teams. * Establish lightweight design reviews, architecture decision records, reference models, and outcome\-based technical standards. #### **Technical Leadership \& Partnership** * Serve as a trusted advisor for cloud, integration, hosting, data, and platform decisions across the BE and I\&D product portfolio. * Communicate architecture choices and trade\-offs in clear business terms to technical teams, product leaders, and senior stakeholders. * This is a hands\-on role: expect 60%\+ of your time on hands\-on technical work (designing, building, and validating solutions), with the remainder focused on technical leadership, mentoring, coaching, and helping others succeed. * Coach engineers on cloud design and foster a culture of reuse, experimentation, ownership, and ongoing #### **You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:** **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience also accepted. * 7\+ years of experience with the following: + Solution architecture, cloud engineering, software platforms, application modernization, or digital product delivery, including hands\-on design and enablement of Microsoft Azure applications or digital products covering application hosting, APIs, integration, identity, data, monitoring, and secure connectivity. + Azure services such as App Service, Functions, API Management, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, virtual networks, private endpoints, and Microsoft Entra ID. + Translating product, user, and business needs into end\-to\-end architectures, transition roadmaps, technical decisions, and reusable patterns. + DevSecOps and automation using Azure DevOps, Git, Bicep, Terraform, or PowerShell. + Balancing innovation, delivery speed, security, reliability, supportability, and cost in a governed enterprise environment, supported by facilitation, problem\-solving, documentation, and communication across business, product, engineering, cybersecurity, and enterprise technology teams. * Ability to travel up to 15% domestically. * Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship. #### **Preferred Qualifications \& Certifications** * Experience with digital product platforms, application portfolio modernization, domain\-driven design, integration architecture, data platforms, or AI workloads. * Experience establishing Azure landing\-zone consumption patterns, environment separation, role\-based access, policy, tagging, cost visibility, observability, resilience, and recovery for product teams. * Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert. Azure Developer Associate, DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Security Engineer Associate, or Terraform Associate certifications are also valued. * Master’s degree in a related technical or engineering field. \#LI\-KC1 $116,049 $198,942 10%

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description: **Who you will be** As an Associate Product Manager at Simple Higher Ed, you will play a vital role in shaping the future of one of our products and support its ongoing growth. You will take charge of the product backlog, ensuring that bugs, features, and enhancements are clearly defined, prioritized, and aligned with company goals. By curating requirements and collaborating across teams, you will help translate customer needs into meaningful product improvements that are easily understandable for engineers. You will work closely with engineers, designers, and customer\-facing teams to support the full product development lifecycle. This includes refining user stories for clarity and feasibility, contributing to strategy discussions, and participating in sprint planning sessions that guide development priorities. You will also help prepare for product releases, coordinating testing, documentation, and communication to ensure that new features and fixes are delivered and communicated seamlessly to our customers. As you grow in the role, you will take on increasing responsibility for supporting roadmap execution and measuring the success of product initiatives. You will track progress against milestones, monitor product performance after release, and help identify opportunities for iteration and optimization. By contributing to the evaluation of key performance indicators, you will ensure that every improvement not only enhances the customer experience but also advances the company’s strategic goals. **What’s In It For You** An opportunity to make a difference—not only in the quality of our product but in the overall experience of higher education. As part of a rapidly growing SaaS software company, you’ll be able to take on multiple responsibilities, develop your expertise in product management, and work cross\-functionally with other teams. There are several clear paths for advancement, allowing you to tailor your career based on what excites you the most. You’ll also receive a competitive compensation package, including a base salary, company\-sponsored healthcare, a 401K plan with matching, paid time off, and more. **About Us** Based in Tampa, Florida, Simple Higher Ed is the fastest\-growing provider of syllabus management technology in North America. Our platform is trusted by institutions ranging from large, AAU universities to small, private colleges, serving diverse educational needs. Simple Syllabus enables instructors to quickly personalize and publish interactive syllabi across mobile, web, and print formats. By centralizing established institutional data like policies, learning objectives, and course content, we save faculty time and ensure easy compliance and reporting, meeting the complex needs of today’s higher education institutions. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Ability to Commute: * Tampa, FL 33607 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Automation Systems Engineer
jobs.description: POSTION DESCRIPTION As a Senior Automation Systems Engineer, you would be leading and participating in the **design of automation \& robotics systems to solve a variety of interesting problems**. Specific technical responsibilities vary by project; however, it is imperative to have a command of engineering fundamentals across multiple engineering disciplines including mechanics, electronics, control systems and embedded firmware. The projects will require understanding how these principles are applied to simple, reliable design. As a senior level role, this job will often require leadership to coordinate and specify deliverables from engineers of other disciplines. Leadership and teamwork skills, as well as written and oral communication skills, are critical to success in this role. * Lead systems level architecture development * Develop algorithms for motion control, both high level motion planning and low\-level feedback control * Program control systems, both in\-product and larger industrial systems * Mentor junior engineers in their development work * Help guide project schedules and break down into schedulable detailed technical tasks * Develop associated tools for testing and validation of product performance * Develop solutions as part of a cross\-discipline team (EE’s, ME’s, FW/SW and Systems Engineers) * Work effectively in a team setting and collaborate openly with other engineers * Work through the product lifecycle, including design, implementation, and verification * Design and execution of design acceptance criteria * Interface with the customers in person, in teleconferences and via written communications QUALIFICATIONS* 7\+ years of applicable experience * Knowledge and experience designing industrial automation including integration of vision systems and industrial robots * Highly motivated with demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision * Excellent organization and analytical skills combined with attention to detail. Ability to prioritize and plan effectively * Strong communications skills, both written and verbal, since no engineering project of substance is achieved by working alone * Knowledge of motion system component selection including motors and sensors * Experience with: + PCL Programming + Python * Basic understanding of electro\-mechanical systems: + Mechanism + Electrical circuits + Control systems \& programming * Bachelors or Masters of Science degree in Engineering or Computer Science from an accredited four\-year university * Ability and willingness to learn new technical skills * Ability to analyze and understand existing designs with an eye toward designing the minimal change set required to meet client objectives * Ethical and honest in every part of the job BENEFICIAL SKILLS* C\+\+ or C\# * Understanding of PCBA design concepts * Experience with Atlassian tools (Confluence, JIRA, BitBucket) * Advanced control design COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS* Base salary range: $140K \- $170K * Excellent Healthcare plan (Medical, Dental, and Vision) fully paid for by the company for the employee; partial payment for dependents * 401(k) plan with company match * Long\-term and short\-term disability, AD\&D and Life Insurance * Paid maternity/new parent leave * 11 Paid holidays * 3 weeks of paid time off (PTO) per year, increasing after 2, 5, and 9 years of service Job location is in San Diego, CA and sometimes requires onsite presence at Simplexity’s clients’ sites. ABOUT SIMPLEXITY Simplifying the Complex. Simplexity is a product development engineering firm, hired by leading technology companies to design their next generation products. In an industry of overly\-complex design and production, we strive for simplicity, reducing product cost and improving reliability for our clients through our Product Development Process. **Why join Simplexity Product Development?** If you’re an engineer who likes variety in your job, you’ll fit right in here. Simplexity works across a **breadth of projects** — from robotics and IoT to medical devices, consumer wearables, automation and more. You won’t be siloed into one tiny piece of the organization; you’ll roll up your sleeves and help solve **real, difficult problems** for demanding clients who expect excellence. Our teams are tight, collaborative, and made up of folks who genuinely want to build something cool and delight our customers. Yet that doesn’t mean grinding for 60\-hours per week, week\-over\-week. We believe that quality, creative work can usually be done in 40\-45 hours per week and that each employee should own their work\-life balance. What we offer is meaningful engineering, technical growth, and the chance to be on the “front line” of product development. If you thrive on variety and want to work with talented engineers on cutting\-edge products, then this could be the place for you. No recruiters please. *Simplexity is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Diverse candidates are encouraged to apply.* *\*\*\* Please be advised that Simplexity Product Development will never ask you to respond to a non\-SimplexityPD domain such as a gmail, ymail, hotmail, etc. If you suspect that you have been contacted by someone impersonating Simplexity Product Development who is using a fraudulent email address, please do not reply. If you are not sure, please fill out a contact form at https://www.simplexitypd.com/contact/ to report the incident. \*\*\** u2TOHbWFC8
